problems: Original mentions 'chapel, lounge and offices' while back-translation says 'prayer room, rest room, and office'. 'Chapel' and 'prayer room' are similar but 'lounge' and 'rest room' differ in connotation and function, which could mislead about the facilities available.

Original specifies 'offices for congregational life' while back-translation says 'office for religious community activities'. The plural 'offices' in the original suggests multiple spaces, whereas the back-translation implies a single 'office', which could mislead about the extent of facilities.
0aa48c71179d.backTranslation: The Pentecostal Church at 5 Grenoble Drive, which holds worship services and Sunday school, and has a prayer room, rest room, and office for religious community activities, recently celebrated its 50th anniversary (September 2025).
0aa48c71179d.source: Pentecostal church at 5 Grenoble Drive offering worship services and Sunday school, with chapel, lounge and offices for congregational life. Recently celebrated its 50th anniversary (September 2025).
0aa48c71179d.text: کلیسای پنطیکاستی در آدرس 5 Grenoble Drive که مراسم عبادت و مکتب یکشنبه برگزار می‌کند و دارای نمازخانه، اتاق استراحت و دفتر برای فعالیت‌های جامعه مذهبی است. اخیراً پنجاهمین سالگرد تأسیس خود را (سپتامبر 2025) جشن گرفت.

problems: The back-translation incorrectly labels the agency as a 'multi-service center for housing and assisting immigrants' instead of a 'multi-service settlement agency', which could mislead residents about the scope of services offered.

The back-translation omits 'settlement support' and incorrectly places 'needs assessment, orientation to life in Canada/Ontario, citizenship preparation classes, assistance with immigration forms' under 'housing support', which could confuse residents about the availability of these services.
The back-translation adds 'home search' under housing assistance, which is not present in the original and could mislead residents about the services provided.
0b810534f69d.backTranslation:
The "TNO Food Collaborative" program (managed by The Neighbourhood Organization) provides free access to food for thousands of people in the Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park neighborhoods, including fresh fruits and vegetables, eggs, and dairy products, which are distributed twice a month, with annual distribution supported by local partners such as Greenwin Cares.

This multi-service center for housing and assisting immigrants offers its services to Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, St. James Town, and Taylor Massey. Services include housing support (needs assessment, orientation to life in Canada/Ontario, citizenship preparation classes, assistance with immigration forms), housing assistance (home search, registration for subsidized housing, access to rental assistance funds, help with energy bill payments), seniors programs (integrated services for seniors, personal support services), youth programs (such as after-school programs for girls), job search services, language training, and counseling for violence against women. These services are free; you can call or visit in person.
0b810534f69d.source:
The TNO Food Collaborative (run by The Neighbourhood Organization) provides free food access to thousands of individuals in the Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park communities, including fresh produce, eggs, and dairy products distributed twice a month, with year-round distribution supported by community partners like Greenwin Cares.

Multi-service settlement agency serving Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, St. James Town and Taylor Massey. Services include settlement support (needs assessment, orientation to life in Canada/Ontario, citizenship preparation classes, immigration forms help), housing assistance (housing search, subsidized housing applications, rent bank access, energy bill assistance), seniors programs (Integrated Services for Seniors, personal support services), youth programs (e.g., after-school girls' programs), employment services, language training, and violence-against-women counselling. Free; call or drop in.
0b810534f69d.text:
برنامه «TNO Food Collaborative» (که توسط The Neighbourhood Organization اداره می‌شود) برای هزاران نفر در محله‌های Thorncliffe Park و Flemingdon Park دسترسی رایگان به مواد غذایی فراهم می‌کند؛ از جمله میوه‌ها و سبزیجات تازه، تخم‌مرغ و محصولات لبنی که دو بار در ماه توزیع می‌شوند و توزیع سالانه آن با حمایت شرکای محلی مانند Greenwin Cares انجام می‌گردد.

این مرکز چندخدمتی برای اسکان و کمک به مهاجران، خدمات خود را به Thorncliffe Park، Flemingdon Park، St. James Town و Taylor Massey ارائه می‌دهد. خدمات شامل پشتیبانی برای اسکان (ارزیابی نیازها، آشنایی با زندگی در کانادا/انتاریو، کلاس‌های آمادگی برای شهروندی، کمک در پر کردن فرم‌های مهاجرتی)، کمک در زمینه مسکن (جستجوی خانه، ثبت‌نام برای خانه‌های یارانه‌ای، دسترسی به صندوق کمک اجاره، کمک در پرداخت قبوض انرژی)، برنامه‌های سالمندان (خدمات یکپارچه برای سالمندان، خدمات حمایت شخصی)، برنامه‌های جوانان (مانند برنامه‌های فوق‌برنامه برای دختران)، خدمات کاریابی، آموزش زبان و مشاوره برای خشونت علیه زنان است. این خدمات رایگان هستند؛ می‌توانید تماس بگیرید یا به صورت حضوری مراجعه کنید.

0baa182fc012.backTranslation: Spiritual Emergency Resources: For spiritual emergencies or to schedule an appointment, you can contact Reverend Dr. Paul Shepherd at 647-700-7129.
0baa182fc012.source: Pastoral emergencies: Rev. Dr. Paul Shepherd can be reached at 647-700-7129 for pastoral emergencies or to book a meeting.
0baa182fc012.text: موارد اضطراری روحانی: برای موارد اضطراری روحانی یا تعیین وقت ملاقات، می‌توانید با جناب روحانی دکتر پل شپرد از طریق شماره 647-700-7129 تماس بگیرید.

0bb8b2cc1244.backTranslation: Toronto Public Health dental clinics provide basic dental care (examinations, X-rays, fillings, cleanings, some root canal treatments, extractions, and dentures) free of charge for eligible children and youth aged 0 to 17, low-income seniors over 65, and clients of certain public health programs who live in Toronto and cannot afford private dental care. Eligibility assessments are conducted in person at the clinic; additionally, a mobile dental clinic offers services to those who have difficulty accessing care.
0bb8b2cc1244.source: Toronto Public Health dental clinics provide free basic dental care (examinations, x-rays, fillings, cleanings, some root canals, extractions, dentures) for eligible children and youth aged 0-17, low-income seniors 65+, and clients of select public health programs who live in Toronto and cannot afford a private dentist. Eligibility is assessed in person at a clinic; a mobile dental clinic also serves clients with difficulty accessing care.
0bb8b2cc1244.text: کلینیک‌های دندانپزشکی Toronto Public Health، مراقبت‌های دندانپزشکی پایه (معاینه، عکس رادیولوژی، پر کردن دندان، جرم‌گیری، برخی درمان‌های عصب‌کشی، کشیدن دندان و دندان مصنوعی) را به صورت رایگان برای کودکان و نوجوانان 0 تا 17 سال واجد شرایط، سالمندان کم‌درآمد بالای 65 سال و مراجعین برخی برنامه‌های بهداشت عمومی که در تورنتو زندگی می‌کنند و توانایی پرداخت هزینه دندانپزشک خصوصی را ندارند، ارائه می‌دهند. بررسی شرایط واجد شرایط بودن در کلینیک و به صورت حضوری انجام می‌شود؛ همچنین یک کلینیک دندانپزشکی سیار نیز برای کسانی که دسترسی به خدمات درمانی برایشان دشوار است، خدمات ارائه می‌دهد.

problems: The term 'Cooling Spaces' is translated as 'Cool spaces', which could mislead residents into thinking it refers to spaces that are simply cool in temperature or atmosphere, rather than designated areas for relief from heat.

0c3f5b3aa79a.backTranslation: Emergency food assistance for families in need (free food distribution twice a month). No shelters, cooling centers, or specific emergency line services have been confirmed by the Food Collaborative.
0c3f5b3aa79a.source: Emergency food support for families in need (free food distribution twice monthly). No shelter, cooling centre, or crisis-line services specific to the Food Collaborative were confirmed.
0c3f5b3aa79a.text: کمک غذایی اضطراری برای خانواده‌های نیازمند (توزیع رایگان غذا دو بار در ماه). هیچ پناهگاه، مرکز خنک‌سازی یا خدمات خط اضطراری خاص Food Collaborative تأیید نشده است.

problems: Speech-language pathology was mistranslated to speech therapy, which could mislead residents about the specific service offered.
0f7fe1d38b46.backTranslation: Home and community health service provider offering services both at home and in clinics: Nursing (RN/RPN), personal care, home support services (meal preparation, housekeeping, companionship, medication reminders), physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, social work, and nutrition. Nurses are available 24/7 for short-term or long-term care needs; also operates nursing and physiotherapy clinics.
0f7fe1d38b46.source: Home and community health care provider offering in-home and clinic-based services: nursing (RN/RPN), personal support, home support (meal prep, housekeeping, companionship, medication reminders), physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, social work and dietetics. Nurses are available 24/7 for short- or long-term care needs; also operates nursing and physiotherapy clinics.
0f7fe1d38b46.text: ارائه‌دهنده خدمات صحی در منزل و جامعه که خدمات در خانه و در کلینیک ارائه می‌دهد: پرستاری (RN/RPN)، کمک‌های شخصی، خدمات پشتیبانی در منزل (آماده‌سازی غذا، نظافت خانه، همراهی و یادآوری مصرف دارو)، فیزیوتراپی، کاردرمانی، گفتاردرمانی، خدمات اجتماعی و تغذیه. پرستاران برای نیازهای مراقبتی کوتاه‌مدت یا بلندمدت به صورت 24 ساعته و در تمام روزهای هفته در دسترس هستند؛ همچنین کلینیک‌های پرستاری و فیزیوتراپی را اداره می‌کند.

1330dcebcb5e.backTranslation: A grassroots group with about 80 members from 75 families in the Thorncliffe and Flemingdon Park areas, who are from various cultures and religions. Their goal is to take on a leadership role in connecting local organizations and residents to build a stronger neighborhood.
1330dcebcb5e.source: A grassroots group of about 80 members from 75 families across Thorncliffe and Flemingdon Parks, from many cultures and religions. Aims to take a leadership role in connecting community organizations and residents to build a stronger neighbourhood.
1330dcebcb5e.text: یه گروه مردمی با حدود 80 نفر عضو از 75 خانواده توی مناطق تورنکلیف و فلمینگدون پارک، که از فرهنگ‌ها و ادیان مختلف هستن. هدفشون اینه که نقش رهبری رو در پیوند دادن سازمان‌های محلی و ساکنان به عهده بگیرن تا یه محله قوی‌تر بسازن.

145d746d96ec.backTranslation: The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of Canada (1 Patriarch Bartholomew Way / 86 Overlea Boulevard, Toronto, 416-429-5757) is the national administrative institution of the Greek Orthodox Church in Canada. Its homepage focuses on church news and celebrations, religious education, and Orthodox religious instruction resources, the Divine Liturgy booklet, prayer book, and the Orthodox icon library; that is, church and spiritual resources rather than social services for the community.
145d746d96ec.source: The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of Canada (1 Patriarch Bartholomew Way / 86 Overlea Boulevard, Toronto, 416-429-5757) is the national administrative body of the Greek Orthodox Church in Canada. Its homepage focuses on church news and celebrations, Orthodox catechism and religious education resources, a Divine Liturgy booklet, prayer book, and an Orthodox icons library — ecclesiastical and spiritual resources rather than community social services.
145d746d96ec.text: اسقف‌نشین ارتدکس یونانی کانادا (1 Patriarch Bartholomew Way / 86 Overlea Boulevard, Toronto, 416-429-5757) نهاد اداری ملی کلیسای ارتدکس یونانی در کانادا است. صفحه اصلی آن بر اخبار و جشن‌های کلیسا، آموزش‌های دینی و منابع تعلیمات مذهبی ارتدکس، کتابچه مراسم عشای ربانی، کتاب دعا و کتابخانه آیکون‌های ارتدکس تمرکز دارد؛ یعنی منابع کلیسایی و معنوی به جای خدمات اجتماعی برای جامعه.

1517bf8b7dbd.backTranslation: The Multi-Service Community Hub is located at 45 Overlea Blvd, 2nd Floor (inside East York Town Centre) and is open Monday to Sunday, from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. The Hub is a one-stop location where residents can access health and social services, programs and social spaces from partner organizations.
1517bf8b7dbd.source: Multi-service community hub at 45 Overlea Blvd, 2nd Floor (inside East York Town Centre), open Monday to Sunday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. One-stop space where residents access health and social services, programs and community spaces from partner organizations.
1517bf8b7dbd.text: مرکز چندخدمتی جامعه در آدرس 45 Overlea Blvd، طبقه دوم (داخل East York Town Centre) واقع شده و از دوشنبه تا یکشنبه، از ساعت 8 صبح تا 8 شب باز است. این مرکز یکجا‌گرد (one-stop) است که ساکنان از طریق آن به خدمات بهداشتی و اجتماعی، برنامه‌ها و فضاهای اجتماعی سازمان‌های همکار دسترسی دارند.

problems: The back-translation incorrectly refers to a 'dialysis center' instead of a 'kidney-care-centre', which could mislead residents about the specific services available.
1538ea5a988e.backTranslation: St. Michael's Hospital has an emergency department (30 Bond St); Unity Health MyChart information and hospital phone numbers are also listed. No specific emergency services for the dialysis center were found; in case of a medical emergency, call 911.
1538ea5a988e.source: St. Michael's Hospital operates an emergency department (30 Bond St.); Unity Health's MyChart and hospital phone lines are listed. No kidney-care-centre-specific emergency services found — in a medical emergency call 911.
1538ea5a988e.text: بیمارستان سنت مایکل یه بخش اورژانس داره (30 Bond St)؛ اطلاعات MyChart یونیتی هلث (Unity Health) و شماره تلفن‌های بیمارستان هم نوشته شده. هیچ خدمات اورژانسی مخصوص مرکز دیالیز پیدا نشد؛ در صورت بروز وضعیت اضطراری پزشکی با شماره 911 تماس بگیرید.

1621e2da2a65.backTranslation: A farm created by local people in Flemingdon Park that produces healthy food for residents. The farm provides opportunities for collective food growing, hosts a weekly summer farmers' market at 150 Grenoble Drive (Thursdays from 3 to 6 p.m., late June to early October), and runs a "Local Farmer" program that provides residents with entrepreneurial opportunities to start micro-agriculture businesses.
1621e2da2a65.source: Community-developed farm in Flemingdon Park growing healthy food for residents. Offers community food growing, a weekly summer farmers' market at 150 Grenoble Drive (Thursdays 3-6pm, late June to early October), and a Community Farmer program giving residents entrepreneurial opportunities to run micro-farm businesses.
1621e2da2a65.text: یک مزرعه که توسط مردم محل در فلینگمدون پارک ایجاد شده و غذای سالم برای ساکنان تولید می‌کند. این مزرعه امکان کشت غذا به صورت جمعی را فراهم می‌کند، هر هفته در تابستان بازار کشاورزان را در آدرس 150 Grenoble Drive برگزار می‌کند (پنجشنبه‌ها از ساعت 3 تا 6 بعدازظهر، از اواخر ژوئن تا اوایل اکتبر)، و برنامه «کشاورز محلی» را اجرا می‌کند که به ساکنان فرصت‌های کارآفرینی برای راه‌اندازی کسب‌وکارهای خرد کشاورزی می‌دهد.

16b01b9ea5a7.backTranslation: Provides emergency and urgent dental care for problems such as toothache and tooth decay.
16b01b9ea5a7.source: Provides emergency and urgent dental care for issues such as dental pain and cavities.
16b01b9ea5a7.text: مراقبت‌های دندانپزشکی اضطراری و فوری برای مشکلاتی مثل درد دندان و پوسیدگی دندان ارائه می‌دهد.

170900592261.backTranslation: Midwifery Clinic (East York/Don Mills) that provides free services supported by the Ministry of Public Health during pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum up to 6 weeks for mother and newborn. Deliveries take place at home, Toronto Birth Centre, or Michael Garron Hospital; midwives are available 24/7 for emergencies, and in case of complications, the patient is referred to an obstetrician, pediatrician, and lactation consultants. Staff speak multiple languages (English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Persian, Dari, and other languages), and prenatal classes including "Newborn 101" are held.
170900592261.source: Midwifery clinic (East York/Don Mills) providing free, Ministry of Health-funded care through pregnancy, labour and birth, and for parent and baby through 6 weeks postpartum. Births are attended at home, the Toronto Birth Centre or Michael Garron Hospital; midwives are on call 24/7 for urgent concerns, and complications are referred to obstetricians, pediatricians and lactation consultants. Multilingual staff (English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Farsi, Dari and others) and prenatal classes including Newborn 101.
170900592261.text: کلینیک مامایی (ایست یورک/دون میلز) که خدمات رایگان و تحت حمایت وزارت صحت عامه را در دوران بارداری، زایمان و پس از زایمان تا 6 هفته برای مادر و نوزاد ارائه می‌دهد. زایمان‌ها در منزل، مرکز زایمان تورنتو یا بیمارستان مایکل گارون انجام می‌شوند؛ ماماها به‌صورت شبانه‌روزی (24/7) برای موارد اضطراری در دسترس هستند و در صورت بروز عوارض، بیمار به متخصص زنان، متخصص اطفال و مشاوران شیردهی ارجاع داده می‌شود. کارکنان به چندین زبان (انگلیسی، عربی، فرانسوی، اسپانیایی، فارسی، دری و سایر زبان‌ها) صحبت می‌کنند و کلاس‌های آموزشی قبل از زایمان از جمله دوره «آشنایی با نوزاد» (Newborn 101) برگزار می‌شود.

problems: The back-translation adds 'unemployment insurance' after 'EI', which is redundant since EI stands for Employment Insurance.
The back-translation uses 'written certificates/affidavits' instead of just 'affidavits', which could be misleading about the scope of document services.
The back-translation uses 'certified copies' instead of 'notarial true copies', which could imply a different type of certification.
The back-translation states 'In-person visits without appointment are not accepted' instead of 'no walk-ins', which is a minor rephrasing but does not change meaning.
The back-translation specifies 'In-person visits only by prior appointment' instead of 'in-person intake by booked appointment', which is a minor rephrasing but does not change meaning.
1a3c95cbc0e2.backTranslation: Free legal advice and legal representation for low-income individuals in the service area (from Lake Ontario to York Mills/401, from Yonge/Don River to Victoria Park Avenue), in four areas: Housing law (eviction prevention, illegal lockouts, tenant rights), Employment law (employment standards, wrongful dismissal, severance pay, EI unemployment insurance), Immigration law (PR permanent residence applications, work permits, citizenship) and Income supports (ODSP, OW, CPP, OAS, GIS, Canada Disability Benefit); Also general legal education and limited document services (written certificates/affidavits, certified copies). Initial contact line: 416-441-1764 extension 1, Monday to Thursday 9:00 to 12:30 (voice message with response within 1 to 3 business days; In-person visits without appointment are not accepted; In-person visits only by prior appointment on Mondays and Wednesdays from 13:30 to 16:30).
1a3c95cbc0e2.source: Free legal advice and representation for low-income people in the catchment area (Lake Ontario to York Mills/401, Yonge/Don River to Victoria Park Ave), in four areas: housing law (eviction prevention, illegal lockouts, tenant rights), employment law (employment standards, wrongful dismissal, severance, EI), immigration law (PR applications, work permits, citizenship) and income supports (ODSP, OW, CPP, OAS, GIS, Canada Disability Benefit); also public legal education and limited document services (affidavits, notarial true copies). Intake Line: 416-441-1764 ext. 1, Mon–Thu 9:00 AM–12:30 PM (voicemail with 1–3 business day callback; no walk-ins; in-person intake by booked appointment Mon/Wed 1:30–4:30 PM).
1a3c95cbc0e2.text: مشاوره حقوقی رایگان و نمایندگی قانونی برای افراد کم‌درآمد در منطقه تحت پوشش (از دریاچه انتاریو تا یورک میلز/401، از یونگ/رودخانه دان تا خیابان ویکتوریا پارک)، در چهار حوزه: قوانین مسکن (جلوگیری از تخلیه، باز کردن غیرقانونی قفل درها، حقوق مستأجران)، قوانین کار (استانداردهای اشتغال، اخراج ناعادلانه، غرامت پایان کار، بیمه بیکاری EI)، قوانین مهاجرت (درخواست‌های اقامت دائم PR، مجوزهای کاری، تابعیت) و حمایت‌های درآمدی (ODSP، OW، CPP، OAS، GIS، کمک‌هزینه ناتوانی کانادا)؛ همچنین آموزش حقوقی عمومی و خدمات محدود اسناد (گواهی‌نامه‌های کتبی/سوگندنامه‌ها، رونوشت‌های رسمی). خط تماس اولیه: 416-441-1764 داخلی 1، دوشنبه تا پنجشنبه ساعت 9:00 تا 12:30 (پیام صوتی با پاسخگویی در عرض 1 تا 3 روز کاری؛ مراجعه حضوری بدون نوبت پذیرفته نمی‌شود؛ پذیرش حضوری فقط با تعیین وقت قبلی روزهای دوشنبه و چهارشنبه ساعت 13:30 تا 16:30).

problems: The back-translation specifies 'heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems (with G2/G3 certification)' instead of the original 'HVAC (G2/G3 licence)', which could mislead residents about the specific licensing requirement.
1ae4b85c3a4e.backTranslation: The TNO program (funded by IRCC) helps newcomers over 18 to get employed in technical and specialized professions. The program offers training courses and job opportunities in construction, heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems (with G2/G3 certification), information technology including data science and artificial intelligence, truck driving (with DZ certification), forklift operation, and traffic management in construction projects. The program is available to permanent residents, convention refugees, and Canadian citizens with an English language level of CLB 5 to 6 and above.
1ae4b85c3a4e.source: TNO program (funded by IRCC) helping newcomers aged 18+ pursue skilled trades and technical careers. Offers training and employment pathways in construction, HVAC (G2/G3 licence), IT including data science and AI, truck driving (DZ licence), forklift operation and construction traffic control. Open to permanent residents, convention refugees and Canadian citizens with CLB 5-6+ English.
1ae4b85c3a4e.text: برنامه TNO (که توسط IRCC تأمین مالی می‌شود) به تازه‌واردان بالای 18 سال کمک می‌کند تا در حرفه‌های فنی و تخصصی مشغول به کار شوند. این برنامه دوره‌های آموزشی و فرصت‌های شغلی در زمینه ساخت‌وساز، سیستم‌های گرمایشی، تهویه و سرمایشی (با گواهینامه G2/G3)، فناوری اطلاعات شامل علوم داده و هوش مصنوعی، رانندگی کامیون (با گواهینامه DZ)، کار با لیفتراک و مدیریت ترافیک در پروژه‌های ساختمانی را ارائه می‌دهد. این برنامه برای ساکنان دائم، پناهندگان تحت کنوانسیون و شهروندان کانادایی با سطح زبان انگلیسی CLB 5 تا 6 و بالاتر در دسترس است.

1be560c4691c.backTranslation: Toronto Fire Services stations that provide 24/7 fire suppression and emergency rescue services in this area: Station 321 (231 McRae Dr), Station 235 (200 Bermondsey Rd), Station 322 (256 Cosburn Ave), Station 224 (1313 Woodbine Ave). Non-emergency phone number: 416-338-9050.
1be560c4691c.source: Toronto Fire Services stations providing 24/7 fire protection and emergency rescue for the area: Station 321 (231 McRae Dr), Station 235 (200 Bermondsey Rd), Station 322 (256 Cosburn Ave), Station 224 (1313 Woodbine Ave). Non-emergency line: 416-338-9050.
1be560c4691c.text: مراکز خدمات آتش‌نشانی تورنتو که به‌صورت 24 ساعته و در تمام روزهای هفته، خدمات اطفای حریق و نجات اضطراری را در این منطقه ارائه می‌دهند: ایستگاه 321 (231 McRae Dr)، ایستگاه 235 (200 Bermondsey Rd)، ایستگاه 322 (256 Cosburn Ave)، ایستگاه 224 (1313 Woodbine Ave). شماره تماس غیراضطراری: 416-338-9050.

problems: The back-translation states 'free play' instead of 'drop-in play', which could mislead residents about the nature of the service.
The back-translation mentions a 'water fountain' instead of a 'splash pad', which is a significant difference in amenities.
The back-translation uses 'baseball fields' instead of 'baseball diamonds', which could cause confusion for residents familiar with the term 'diamonds'.
235e1072c4f3.backTranslation: The city's social center is located at 150 Grenoble Drive in Flemingdon Park, which has an indoor playground called Playground Paradise (free play for children up to 12 years old, $3 per child, wearing socks is mandatory, parents or guardians must accompany the child). It also has indoor and outdoor playgrounds, picnic areas, a water fountain, a community garden, multi-purpose sports fields, baseball fields, and ball hockey and basketball courts. At the same address, the Flemingdon Park EarlyON Center is located, which offers free and open programs for young children and families.
235e1072c4f3.source: City community centre at 150 Grenoble Drive in Flemingdon Park with the Playground Paradise indoor playground (drop-in play for children up to age 12, $3 per child, socks required, parent or guardian must accompany). Also has indoor and outdoor playgrounds, a picnic area, splash pad, community garden, multipurpose sports fields, baseball diamonds, and ball hockey and basketball courts. The same address hosts Flemingdon Park EarlyON, offering free drop-in early-childhood and family programs.
235e1072c4f3.text: مرکز اجتماعی شهر در 150 گرینوبل درایو در فلمنگدون پارک واقع شده است که دارای زمین بازی سرپوشیده ی پلی گروند پارادایز است (بازی آزاد برای کودکان تا 12 سالگی، 3 دلار برای هر کودک، پوشیدن جوراب الزامی است، والدین یا سرپرست باید همراه کودک باشند). همچنین دارای زمین بازی سرپوشیده و روباز، فضای پیک نیک، فواره ی آب، باغچه ی اجتماعی، زمین های ورزشی چند منظوره، زمین های بیسبال، و زمین های هاکی توپ و بسکتبال است. در همین آدرس، مرکز فلمنگدون پارک ارلی آن واقع شده است که برنامه های رایگان و آزاد برای کودکان خردسال و خانواده ها را ارائه می دهد.

problems: The term 'emergency counseling' could be misleading compared to 'crisis counselling', as it implies a more immediate and urgent service than what might be offered.
The phrase 'activity report page' is less specific than 'impact page', which could cause confusion for someone trying to locate the information.
2839a2e22b9b.backTranslation: Provides emergency counseling (on their activity report page, it is mentioned that 207 people have benefited from these services).
2839a2e22b9b.source: Offers crisis counselling (their impact page reports 207 clients received it).
2839a2e22b9b.text: مشاوره اضطراری ارائه می‌دهد (در صفحه گزارش فعالیت‌هایشان ذکر شده که 207 نفر از این خدمات بهره‌مند شده‌اند).

problems: The back-translation incorrectly states the Ontario Science Centre is 'formerly active', which could mislead residents about its current status.
2b036077722c.backTranslation: Large, valley-like public park at 73 Thorncliffe Park Drive, along the Don River, between Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, and the Ontario Science Centre (formerly active). Facilities: 18-hole disc golf course (established 2011, free), archery range (one of only two public ranges in Canada, free but unsupervised), running and cycling trails, Nordic skiing and horseback riding trails, shelters and picnic areas, fire pits, basketball courts, washrooms and water fountains (water and washrooms closed in winter).
2b036077722c.source: Large public ravine park at 73 Thorncliffe Park Drive, along the Don River between Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park and the former Ontario Science Centre. Amenities: 18-hole disc golf course (est. 2011, free), archery range (one of only two public ranges in Canada, free but unsupervised), jogging/cycling paths, Nordic skiing and equestrian trails, picnic shelters/areas, fire pits, basketball courts, washrooms and drinking water fountains (water and washrooms closed in winter).
2b036077722c.text: پارک عمومی بزرگ و دره‌مانند در آدرس 73 Thorncliffe Park Drive، در امتداد رودخانه دون، بین Thorncliffe Park، Flemingdon Park و مرکز علوم انتاریو (که قبلاً فعال بود). امکانات: زمین دیس‌گلف با 18 حفره (تأسیس 2011، رایگان)، میدان تیراندازی با کمان (یکی از تنها دو میدان عمومی در کانادا، رایگان اما بدون ناظر)، مسیرهای دویدن و دوچرخه‌سواری، مسیرهای اسکی نوردیک و اسب‌سواری، سایبان‌ها و فضاهای پیک‌نیک، آتشدان‌ها، زمین‌های بسکتبال، سرویس بهداشتی و آبخوری (آب و سرویس‌های بهداشتی در زمستان بسته هستند).

2d4e28c7351b.backTranslation: Note the usual safety exercises and safe entry; no special social services for emergencies are mentioned.
2d4e28c7351b.source: Notes routine safety drills and secure entry; no emergency-specific community services listed.
2d4e28c7351b.text: تمرینات معمولی ایمنی و ورود امن رو یادداشت کن؛ هیچ خدمات اجتماعی خاص برای مواقع اضطراری ذکر نشده.

2d84f26c9897.backTranslation: Designated Cooling Space: Provides an indoor, air-conditioned environment for people to find relief during heat warnings or extreme heat advisories.
2d84f26c9897.source: Designated cooling space: provides air-conditioned indoor relief during extreme heat warnings/alerts.
2d84f26c9897.text: فضای خنک‌کننده مشخص‌شده: در زمان هشدار یا اعلامیه‌های گرمای شدید، محیطی سرپوشیده و مجهز به تهویه مطبوع برای آسایش مردم فراهم می‌کند.

problems: The original specifies 'Drinking Fountain facility' while the back-translation uses 'water fountain facilities', which could imply multiple fountains instead of one.
The original lists 'ball diamonds' while the back-translation uses 'baseball fields', which are synonymous but could cause confusion for non-native speakers.
The original mentions 'ball hockey pad' while the back-translation uses 'field hockey field', which refers to different sports.
The original lists 'outdoor tracks' while the back-translation uses 'a running track', which could imply a single track instead of multiple.
The original mentions 'sport fields' while the back-translation uses 'sports fields', which is a minor difference but could be noted for consistency.
2de0ec486420.backTranslation: The toronto.ca page is dedicated to the water fountain facilities in Flemingdon Park (near Don Mills Road and Eglinton Avenue East). This water fountain is listed as one of the official facilities of this 13.3-hectare park, which also includes baseball fields, a field hockey field, a cricket field, a multi-purpose field, 4 outdoor basketball courts, a running track, 4 playgrounds (playground renovated in 2025), a splash pad, a community garden, 6 picnic shelters, sports fields, and parking.
2de0ec486420.source: The toronto.ca page is specifically for the Drinking Fountain facility within Flemingdon Park (near Don Mills Rd and Eglinton Ave E). The fountain is listed as an official amenity of this 13.3-hectare park, which also has ball diamonds, a ball hockey pad, cricket pitch, multipurpose field, 4 outdoor basketball courts, outdoor tracks, 4 playgrounds (playground updated in 2025), splash pad, community garden, 6 picnic shelters, sport fields and parking lots.
2de0ec486420.text: صفحه toronto.ca مخصوص تأسیسات آب‌نوشان در پارک فلِمینگدون (نزدیک جاده دان میلز و خیابان اگلینتون شرقی) است. این آب‌نوشان به عنوان یکی از امکانات رسمی این پارک به مساحت 13.3 هکتار ذکر شده است؛ پارکی که همچنین دارای زمین‌های بیسبال، زمین هاکی روی چمن، زمین کریکت، زمین چندمنظوره، 4 زمین بسکتبال روباز، پیست دویدن، 4 زمین بازی (زمین بازی در سال 2025 بازسازی شده)، آب‌پاش تفریحی، باغ مشترک محله، 6 سایبان پیک‌نیک، زمین‌های ورزشی و پارکینگ است.

2f2cb7da74f4.backTranslation: The City of Toronto's outdoor public pool at 5 Leaside Park Drive (in Leaside Park), which is open in the summer for recreational swimming and lane swimming. This pool is accessible for people using wheelchairs and has accessible change rooms, a level entrance to the pool deck, and a designated Wheel-Trans drop-off area in the Leaside Park Drive parking lot.
2f2cb7da74f4.source: City of Toronto outdoor public swimming pool at 5 Leaside Park Drive (in Leaside Park), open seasonally in summer for recreational and lane swimming. Listed as wheelchair accessible with accessible change rooms, level entry to the pool deck and Wheel-Trans drop-off at the Leaside Park Drive lot.
2f2cb7da74f4.text: استخر عمومی روباز شهر تورنتو در آدرس 5 Leaside Park Drive (در پارک لیزاید)، که در فصل تابستان برای شنای تفریحی و شنا در خطوط مخصوص باز است. این استخر برای استفاده افراد با ویلچر مناسب است و دارای رختکن‌های مناسب، ورودی هم‌سطح برای رسیدن به محوطه استخر و توقفگاه مخصوص سرویس Wheel-Trans در پارکینگ Leaside Park Drive می‌باشد.

313e1f70434b.backTranslation: A local women's organization that led the revitalization of R.V. Burgess Park and, in collaboration with others, created amenities such as a community garden, park café, water play area (splash pad), benches, lighting system, and the only outdoor tandoor oven in a public park in North America. The organization focuses on strengthening social ties and intercultural activities in Thorncliffe Park.
313e1f70434b.source: Grassroots women's community organization that led the revitalization of R.V. Burgess Park, co-creating amenities such as a community garden, park cafe, splash pad, seating, lighting and the only outdoor tandoor oven in a North American public park. Focuses on community building and intercultural work in Thorncliffe Park.
313e1f70434b.text: یک سازمان محلی زنان که رهبری بازسازی پارک R.V. Burgess را بر عهده داشت و با همکاری دیگران امکاناتی مانند باغچه عمومی، کافه پارک، محل بازی با آب (اسپلش پد)، نیمکت‌ها، سیستم روشنایی و تنها تنور تندور روباز در یک پارک عمومی در آمریکای شمالی را ایجاد کرد. این سازمان بر تقویت پیوندهای اجتماعی و فعالیت‌های بین‌فرهنگی در Thorncliffe Park تمرکز دارد.

32dfa11d6223.backTranslation: Multi-service immigration office serving residents of Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, St. James Town, and Taylor Massey. Services include immigration support (needs assessment, orientation to life in Canada/Ontario, citizenship preparation classes, assistance with immigration forms), housing assistance (home search, subsidized housing registration, access to rental assistance fund, help with energy bills), seniors programs (integrated services for seniors, personal support services), youth programs (e.g., after-school programs for girls), job search services, language training, and counseling for violence against women. These services are free; call or visit in person.
32dfa11d6223.source: Multi-service settlement agency serving Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, St. James Town and Taylor Massey. Services include settlement support (needs assessment, orientation to life in Canada/Ontario, citizenship preparation classes, immigration forms help), housing assistance (housing search, subsidized housing applications, rent bank access, energy bill assistance), seniors programs (Integrated Services for Seniors, personal support services), youth programs (e.g., after-school girls' programs), employment services, language training, and violence-against-women counselling. Free; call or drop in.
32dfa11d6223.text: اداره خدمات مهاجرتی چندمنظوره که به ساکنان Thorncliffe Park، Flemingdon Park، St. James Town و Taylor Massey خدمات ارائه می‌دهد. خدمات شامل پشتیبانی مهاجرتی (ارزیابی نیازها، آشنایی با زندگی در کانادا/انتاریو، کلاس‌های آمادگی برای شهروندی، کمک در تکمیل فرم‌های مهاجرتی)، کمک در زمینه مسکن (جستجوی خانه، ثبت‌نام برای خانه‌های یارانه‌ای، دسترسی به صندوق کمک اجاره، کمک در پرداخت قبوض انرژی)، برنامه‌های سالمندان (خدمات یکپارچه برای سالمندان، خدمات پشتیبانی شخصی)، برنامه‌های جوانان (مثلاً برنامه‌های فوق‌برنامه برای دختران)، خدمات کاریابی، آموزش زبان و مشاوره برای خشونت علیه زنان است. این خدمات رایگان هستند؛ تماس بگیرید یا به صورت حضوری مراجعه کنید.

problems: The back-translation states services were 'extracted from the local Thorncliffe Hub directory' instead of 'drawn from the Thorncliffe Hub grassroots listing'. This could mislead residents about the source of the services.
The back-translation uses 'social processes' instead of 'community processes'. This could slightly alter the perceived focus of the group's engagement efforts.
The back-translation adds 'institutions' as a group Engaged Communities connects, which is not mentioned in the original text. This adds information not present in the original.
37155594f70b.backTranslation: The home page showed the error “Page not found”, so services were extracted from the local Thorncliffe Hub directory and social resource pages of other organizations. Engaged Communities is the same resident organizing group mentioned above; it was established in November 2019 to address youth violence, increases resident engagement in social processes, and connects residents, institutions, schools, police, and politicians. In 2023, the group, in collaboration with Flemingdon Health Centre, was a recipient of the City of Toronto’s Youth Violence Prevention Grant.
37155594f70b.source: The homepage returned a 'Page Not Found' error, so services were drawn from the Thorncliffe Hub grassroots listing and third-party community resource pages. Engaged Communities is the same resident organizing group described above: started November 2019 to address youth violence, builds resident engagement in community processes, and connects residents, agencies, schools, police, and politicians. It was a 2023 City of Toronto Youth Violence Prevention Grant recipient in partnership with Flemingdon Health Centre.
37155594f70b.text: صفحه اصلی خطای «صفحه یافت نشد» را نشان داد، بنابراین خدمات از فهرست محلی Thorncliffe Hub و صفحات منابع اجتماعی سایر سازمان‌ها استخراج شد. Engaged Communities همان گروه سازمان‌دهی ساکنان است که در بالا ذکر شد؛ این گروه نوامبر 2019 برای مقابله با خشونت جوانان تأسیس شد، مشارکت ساکنان را در فرآیندهای اجتماعی افزایش می‌دهد و ساکنان، نهادها، مدارس، پلیس و سیاستمداران را به هم متصل می‌کند. این گروه در سال 2023، در همکاری با Flemingdon Health Centre، دریافت‌کننده کمک مالی پیشگیری از خشونت جوانان از سوی شهرداری تورنتو بود.

37afb9eb8339.backTranslation: No special service for emergency conditions has been mentioned. (This group has previously distributed food packages as a charity activity during the epidemic and after it.)
37afb9eb8339.source: No emergency-specific services listed. (The group has previously distributed food hampers during and after the pandemic as a charitable activity.)
37afb9eb8339.text: هیچ خدمت ویژه برای شرایط اضطراری ذکر نشده است. (این گروه قبلاً به عنوان یک فعالیت خیریه، در زمان همه‌گیری و پس از آن بسته‌های مواد غذایی توزیع کرده است.)

3904b64dcef4.backTranslation: The neighborhood recreation and social center is located at 48 Thorncliffe Park Drive, housed in a building with the Thorncliffe library branch. This small (12,000 square feet) but busy neighborhood center offers indoor fields, a childcare center, meeting space, workshops such as mental health and wellness classes, and recreational programs.
3904b64dcef4.source: City community recreation centre at 48 Thorncliffe Park Drive, co-located with the Thorncliffe library branch. A small (12,000 sq ft) but heavily used neighbourhood hub offering indoor courts, a daycare centre, meeting space, workshops such as mental health and wellbeing sessions, and recreation programs.
3904b64dcef4.text: مرکز تفریحی و اجتماعی محله در آدرس 48 Thorncliffe Park Drive که در یک ساختمان با شعبه کتابخانه Thorncliffe قرار دارد. این مرکز محله‌ای کوچک (12,000 فوت مربع) اما پررفت‌وآمد است که زمین‌های سرپوشیده، مرکز نگهداری کودکان، فضای برگزاری جلسات، کارگاه‌هایی مانند کلاس‌های سلامت روان و تندرستی، و برنامه‌های تفریحی را ارائه می‌دهد.

39681ff66eee.backTranslation: The TDSB Early Learning Academy at 82 Thorncliffe Park Dr is for young children and has a regular daily schedule for entry, lunch, and dismissal. Parents report their children's absences via the Safe Arrival number (1-833-250-2290).
39681ff66eee.source: TDSB early learning academy at 82 Thorncliffe Park Dr for young children, with structured daily routines for arrival, lunch and dismissal. Parents report absences through the Safe Arrival number (1-833-250-2290).
39681ff66eee.text: آکادمی یادگیری زودهنگام TDSB در آدرس 82 Thorncliffe Park Dr برای کودکان کوچک است و برنامه روزانه منظمی برای ورود، ناهار و خروج دارد. والدین غیبت کودکان خود را از طریق شماره Safe Arrival (1-833-250-2290) اطلاع می‌دهند.

problems: Replaced 'dietitians' with 'nutritionist services', which may imply a different scope of practice.
Replaced 'chiropody' with 'podiatry', which could be confusing as chiropody is a specific term used in Canada for foot care.
Replaced 'prenatal programs' with 'pregnancy programs', which may not fully capture the scope of prenatal care.
3dc2fd8bba11.backTranslation: Local non-profit health center (active since 1975) at 10 Gateway Blvd, offering free primary care services by doctors and nurse practitioners to residents in its coverage area; no OHIP card or medical referral is required. The center also provides individual and family/mental health counseling, chronic disease prevention and management (diabetes, lung and heart health), nutritionist services, podiatry (foot care), nutritional counseling, sexual health clinic (in collaboration with Toronto Public Health), pregnancy programs, and health promotion programs (exercise, wellness, and healthy cooking) for seniors, women, youth, and newcomers.
3dc2fd8bba11.source: Non-profit community health centre (operating since 1975) at 10 Gateway Blvd offering free primary care from doctors and nurse practitioners for residents in its catchment area — no OHIP card or medical referral required. Also offers individual and family counselling/mental health services, chronic disease prevention and management (diabetes, lung and heart health), dietitians, chiropody (foot care), nutrition counselling, a sexual health clinic (with Toronto Public Health), prenatal programs, and health promotion programs (exercise, wellness, healthy cooking) for seniors, women, youth and newcomers.
3dc2fd8bba11.text: مرکز بهداشتی غیرانتفاعی محلی (فعال از سال 1975) در آدرس 10 Gateway Blvd که خدمات مراقبت‌های اولیه رایگان توسط دکتران و پرستاران متخصص (Nurse Practitioners) را برای ساکنان منطقه تحت پوشش خود ارائه می‌دهد؛ برای دریافت این خدمات به کارت OHIP یا معرفی‌نامه پزشکی نیاز نیست. این مرکز همچنین خدمات مشاوره فردی و خانوادگی/سلامت روان، پیشگیری و مدیریت بیماری‌های مزمن (دیابت، سلامت ریه و قلب)، خدمات متخصصان تغذیه، پودیاتری (مراقبت از پا)، مشاوره تغذیه، کلینیک سلامت جنسی (با همکاری Toronto Public Health)، برنامه‌های دوران بارداری و برنامه‌های ارتقای سلامت (ورزش، تندرستی و آشپزی سالم) را برای سالمندان، زنان، جوانان و تازه‌واردان ارائه می‌کند.

411f70e150dd.backTranslation: The Greek Orthodox Church at 30 Thorncliffe Park Drive (with a capacity of over 600 seated worshippers and sufficient parking), led by the parish priest, Father Apostolos Gkolias (apostolosgkolias@yahoo.com; church phone +1 (416) 425-2485, info@togreekcom.org). Sunday and holiday services: Orthros (morning prayer) from 8:30 to 10:00 AM and Divine Liturgy from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM; it also holds Sunday school registration and other church programs.
411f70e150dd.source: Greek Orthodox parish at 30 Thorncliffe Park Drive (capacity 600+ seated worshipers, ample parking), led by Parish Priest Fr. Apostolos Gkolias (apostolosgkolias@yahoo.com; church phone +1 (416) 425-2485, info@togreekcom.org). Sunday and Feast Day services: Orthros-Matins 8:30–10:00 AM and Divine Liturgy 10:00 AM–12:00 noon; runs Sunday School registration and other church programs.
411f70e150dd.text: کلیسای ارتدکس یونانی در آدرس 30 Thorncliffe Park Drive (ظرفیت بیش از 600 نفر برای نمازگزاران نشسته و پارکینگ کافی)، به رهبری کشیش کلیسا، پدر آپوستولوس گکولیاس (apostolosgkolias@yahoo.com؛ تلفن کلیسا +1 (416) 425-2485، info@togreekcom.org). مراسم روزهای یکشنبه و اعیاد: ارتوس (نماز صبحگاهی) ساعت 8:30 تا 10:00 صبح و مراسم عشای ربانی ساعت 10:00 صبح تا 12:00 ظهر؛ ثبت‌نام مدرسه یکشنبه و سایر برنامه‌های کلیسا را نیز برگزار می‌کند.

4341d8807857.backTranslation: The toronto.ca page is dedicated to the drinking fountain facilities in R.V. Burgess Park (address: 46 Thorncliffe Park Dr, near Thorncliffe Park Dr and Overlea Blvd). This drinking fountain is listed among the official amenities of this 1.5-hectare neighborhood park, which features a splash pad, two children's playgrounds, a community garden, a covered picnic area, and Canada's first public tandoor oven; visitors have also noted the presence of drinking water facilities at this location.
4341d8807857.source: The toronto.ca page is specifically for the Drinking Fountain facility within R.V. Burgess Park (46 Thorncliffe Park Dr, near Thorncliffe Park Dr and Overlea Blvd). The fountain is listed as an official amenity of this 1.5-hectare neighbourhood park, which also has a splash pad, two playgrounds, a community garden, sheltered picnic area and Canada's first public tandoor oven, plus drinking water facilities noted by visitors.
4341d8807857.text: صفحه toronto.ca مخصوص تأسیسات آب‌نوش (Drinking Fountain) در پارک R.V. Burgess (آدرس: 46 Thorncliffe Park Dr، نزدیک Thorncliffe Park Dr و Overlea Blvd) است. این آب‌نوش در فهرست امکانات رسمی این پارک محله‌ای به مساحت 1.5 هکتار قرار دارد که دارای فضای بازی با آب (splash pad)، دو زمین بازی کودکان، باغ مشترک محله، محل پیک‌نیک سرپوشیده و اولین تنور تندور عمومی کانادا است؛ همچنین بازدیدکنندگان به وجود امکانات آب آشامیدنی در این مکان اشاره کرده‌اند.

problems: Missing information: 'Tenant Supports' is more specific than 'support for tenants', which could mislead residents about the scope of services offered.

44a718e6efa5.backTranslation: A grassroots group established in 2019 by residents of Thorncliffe and Flemingdon Park of diverse ages and cultures. The group implements educational projects to reduce indirect greenhouse gas emissions (buildings, waste, transportation) in line with Toronto's TransformTO strategy, promotes sustainable and "climate-friendly" living habits, and helps include seniors who have been isolated from the community during the pandemic.
44a718e6efa5.source: Community grassroots group founded in 2019 by Thorncliffe & Flemingdon Park residents of all ages and cultures. Runs education initiatives on reducing indirect greenhouse gas emissions (buildings, waste, transportation) aligned with Toronto's TransformTO strategy, promotes 'climate-wise' sustainable living habits, and helps include seniors who became isolated during the pandemic.
44a718e6efa5.text: یک گروه مردمی که در سال 2019 توسط ساکنان Thorncliffe و Flemingdon Park با سنین و فرهنگ‌های مختلف تأسیس شد. این گروه پروژه‌های آموزشی برای کاهش انتشار غیرمستقیم گازهای گلخانه‌ای (ساختمان‌ها، پسماند، حمل‌ونقل) را مطابق با استراتژی TransformTO تورنتو اجرا می‌کند، عادت‌های زندگی پایدار و «مناسب برای اقلیم» را ترویج می‌دهد و به گنجاندن سالمندان که در دوران همه‌گیری از جامعه جدا شده‌اند، کمک می‌کند.

4a8be4c87e8f.backTranslation: The museum offers variable exhibitions, concerts, and practical workshops (e.g., art workshops and music programs). It runs educational programs for schools, including in-person and virtual field visits, educational resources for teachers, and online courses, plus a free online content library with podcasts, 3D tours, and artist interviews.
4a8be4c87e8f.source: Museum with rotating exhibitions, concerts and hands-on workshops (e.g., art workshops, music events). Runs school programs including onsite and virtual field trips, teacher resources and online courses, plus a free online content library with podcasts, 3D tours and artist talks.
4a8be4c87e8f.text: موزیم با نمایشگاه‌های متغیر، کنسرت‌ها و کارگاه‌های عملی (مثلاً کارگاه‌های هنری و برنامه‌های موسیقی). برنامه‌های آموزشی برای مدارس رو اجرا می‌کنه؛ شامل بازدیدهای میدانی حضوری و مجازی، منابع آموزشی برای معلمان و دوره‌های آنلاین، به‌علاوه یه کتابخانه محتوای رایگان آنلاین با پادکست‌ها، تورهای سه‌بعدی و گفتگو با هنرمندان.

problems: The back-translation incorrectly states the Toronto Rent Bank as a 'subsidy' instead of an 'Access Centre', which could mislead residents about the nature of the service.
The back-translation refers to the Emergency Energy Fund as a 'hotline' instead of a 'call centre', which might imply a different level of service or support.
4c0ad54aefbb.backTranslation: Through its program to combat violence against women, it provides crisis intervention and counseling services; it acts as an access center for the Toronto Rent Bank subsidy and the Emergency Energy Fund hotline (416-397-7368).
4c0ad54aefbb.source: Offers crisis intervention and counselling through its violence-against-women program; acts as a Toronto Rent Bank Access Centre and Emergency Energy Fund call centre (416-397-7368).
4c0ad54aefbb.text: از طریق برنامه خود برای مقابله با خشونت علیه زنان، خدمات مداخله در مواقع بحران و مشاوره ارائه می‌دهد؛ به عنوان مرکز دسترسی به بانک کمک‌هزینه اجاره مسکن تورنتو و مرکز تماس صندوق اضطراری انرژی فعالیت می‌کند (416-397-7368).

5141105643c3.backTranslation: A multidisciplinary consulting firm that collaborates with various organizations across different industries (its clients have included TNO, OCAD University, and the Islamic Society of Toronto). The company's services include market and user research, urban design and planning, project and program management, operational support, governance and leadership consulting, business consulting, integration of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, branding and media, sales optimization, and conducting training sessions and workshops.
5141105643c3.source: Multi-disciplinary consulting firm working with organizations across industries (clients have included TNO, OCAD University and the Islamic Society of Toronto). Services include market and user research, design and urban planning, project and program management, operational support, governance and leadership advisory, business consulting, AI and emerging-tech integration, branding and media, sales optimization, and training and workshops.
5141105643c3.text: شرکت مشاوره‌ای چندرشته‌ای که با سازمان‌های مختلف در صنایع گوناگون همکاری می‌کند (مشتریان آن شامل TNO، دانشگاه OCAD و انجمن اسلامی تورنتو بوده‌اند). خدمات این شرکت شامل تحقیقات بازار و کاربران، طراحی و برنامه‌ریزی شهری، مدیریت پروژه و برنامه، پشتیبانی عملیاتی، مشاوره در زمینه حکمرانی و رهبری، مشاوره کسب‌وکار، ادغام هوش مصنوعی و فناوری‌های نوظهور، برندسازی و رسانه، بهینه‌سازی فروش، و برگزاری دوره‌های آموزشی و کارگاه‌ها است.

56ab2826fe5e.backTranslation: Licensed childcare center at 9 Grenoble Dr (Flemingdon Park) for toddlers, preschool, kindergarten, and school-age children; with reduced CWELCC fees and subsidy eligibility. Care services are provided in English, Spanish, Gujarati, and Ukrainian; prepared meals with halal and vegetarian options are served.
56ab2826fe5e.source: Licensed childcare at 9 Grenoble Dr (Flemingdon Park) for toddler, preschool, kindergarten and school-age children, with CWELCC reduced fees and subsidy available. Care offered in English, Spanish, Gujarati and Ukrainian; catered meals with halal and vegetarian options.
56ab2826fe5e.text: مرکز مراقبت از کودکان دارای مجوز در آدرس 9 Grenoble Dr (Flemingdon Park) برای کودکان نوپا، پیش‌دبستانی، مهدکودک و کودکان در سن مدرسه؛ با هزینه‌های کاهش‌یافته CWELCC و امکان دریافت یارانه. خدمات مراقبت به زبان‌های انگلیسی، اسپانیایی، گجراتی و اوکراینی ارائه می‌شود؛ غذاهای آماده با گزینه‌های حلال و گیاهی سرو می‌گردد.

problems: The back-translation states the arena was 'named in 2009' instead of 'renamed in 2009', which could imply it was newly built that year rather than renamed.
The back-translation uses 'fire station' instead of 'fire hall', which may cause confusion for residents unfamiliar with the term.
57480d0bcd4e.backTranslation: The City Arena at 165 Grenoble Dr (named in 2009 in honour of Canadian hockey star Angela James) is available for ice skating and hockey programs, along with adjacent public tennis courts. Note: The City has announced plans (for 2026) to build a new Flemingdon fire station at 165 Grenoble Dr, which would eliminate two of the four tennis courts; the current status is unclear.
57480d0bcd4e.source: City arena at 165 Grenoble Dr (renamed in 2009 for Canadian hockey star Angela James) for ice skating and hockey programs, plus adjacent public tennis courts. Note: the City announced plans (2026) to build a new Flemingdon fire hall at 165 Grenoble Dr, which would remove two of the four tennis courts — status uncertain.
57480d0bcd4e.text: سالن شهری در آدرس 165 Grenoble Dr (که در سال 2009 به افتخار آنجلا جیمز، ستاره هاکی کانادا، نام‌گذاری شد) برای برنامه‌های اسکیت روی یخ و هاکی، به همراه زمین‌های تنیس عمومی مجاور آن قرار دارد. توجه: شهرداری برنامه‌هایی (برای سال 2026) برای ساخت یک ایستگاه آتش‌نشانی جدید Flemingdon در آدرس 165 Grenoble Dr اعلام کرده است که در نتیجه آن دو تا از چهار زمین تنیس حذف خواهند شد؛ وضعیت فعلی نامشخص است.

5b54b1c20dbc.backTranslation: A grassroots movement aimed at raising awareness about mental health and reducing the social stigma associated with it in the South Asian community, particularly for newcomers and first and second-generation immigrants.
5b54b1c20dbc.source: A community-led initiative raising awareness of mental health and reducing its stigma in the South Asian community, particularly for newcomers and immigrants of first and second generations.
5b54b1c20dbc.text: یه حرکت مردمی که هدفش آگاهی‌بخشی درباره سلامت روان و کم کردن انگ اجتماعی مرتبط با اون در جامعه جنوب آسیا، به‌ویژه برای تازه‌واردان و مهاجران نسل اول و دوم، است.

5d864949c117.backTranslation: Toronto Police, 55 Division (101 Coxwell Ave, 416-808-5500) — This division serves the eastern areas, including the Thorncliffe/Flemingdon area; it provides community policing, non-emergency report filing, and victim support. Note: Divisions 54 and 55 are planned to merge into a new, consolidated station at 1627 Danforth Ave (former TTC Danforth Garage).
5d864949c117.source: Toronto Police Service, 55 Division (101 Coxwell Ave, 416-808-5500) — the division serving the east end including the Thorncliffe/Flemingdon area; provides community policing, non-emergency reporting, and victim support. Note: 54 and 55 Divisions are planned to amalgamate into a new consolidated station at 1627 Danforth Ave (former TTC Danforth garage).
5d864949c117.text: پلیس تورنتو، بخش 55 (101 Coxwell Ave, 416-808-5500) — این بخش خدماتش را در مناطق شرقی، از جمله منطقه Thorncliffe/Flemingdon ارائه می‌دهد؛ خدمات پلیس محله‌ای، ثبت گزارش‌های غیراضطراری و حمایت از قربانیان را انجام می‌دهد. توجه: برنامه‌ریزی شده است که بخش‌های 54 و 55 در یک پاسگاه جدید و یکپارچه در 1627 Danforth Ave (گاراژ سابق TTC Danforth) با هم ادغام شوند.

5d959a5ff47c.backTranslation: The "Pride In Heritage" Children's Center is a multicultural, non-profit, and community-based childcare center located within the Gateway Public School at 55 Gateway Blvd, Toronto (416-467-5981). This center provides inclusive childcare services without any discrimination in a safe and supportive environment and is managed by a volunteer board of directors; the center treats all individuals with respect and dignity, regardless of their background.
5d959a5ff47c.source: Pride In Heritage Children's Centre is a non-profit, community-based multicultural child care centre located inside Gateway Public School at 55 Gateway Blvd, Toronto (416-467-5981). It offers inclusive, bias-free child care in a safe, nurturing environment, run by a volunteer Board of Directors; it treats all individuals with dignity regardless of background.
5d959a5ff47c.text: مرکز کودکان «Pride In Heritage» یه مرکز مراقبت از کودکان چندفرهنگی، غیرانتفاعی و مردمی است که در داخل مدرسه دولتی Gateway واقع در 55 Gateway Blvd، تورنتو (416-467-5981) قرار دارد. این مرکز خدمات مراقبت از کودکان را به صورت فراگیر و بدون هیچگونه تبعیض در محیطی امن و حمایتی ارائه می‌دهد و توسط هیئت مدیره‌ای داوطلب اداره می‌شود؛ این مرکز با احترام و حفظ کرامت با همه افراد، فارغ از پیشینه‌شان، برخورد می‌کند.

6112e2d3ed72.backTranslation: Free and confidential help is provided 24/7 by phone by employed doctors (416-429-4991). It is explicitly stated that emergency services or walk-in appointments are not provided — in case of emergencies, call 911.
6112e2d3ed72.source: Provides free, confidential 24-hour on-call assistance from staff physicians (416-429-4991). Explicitly states it does not offer emergency or walk-in services — call 911 in an emergency.
6112e2d3ed72.text: کمک رایگان و محرمانه به صورت شبانه‌روزی و تلفنی توسط داکتران کارمند ارائه می‌دهد (416-429-4991). صراحتاً ذکر شده که خدمات اورژانسی یا پذیرش بدون وقت قبلی ارائه نمی‌شود — در مواقع اضطراری با شماره 911 تماس بگیرید.

6166d8860ebc.backTranslation: Valley Park Middle School is a TDSB middle school that operates for grades six to eight and covers about 1,100 students from the neighborhoods of Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park. Its address is 130 Overlea Blvd, East York. The school focuses on providing a safe and supportive learning environment that is built on respect, responsibility, and safety; in the reviewed homepage text, no programs for French immersion, English as a Second Language (ESL), or special education were mentioned.
6166d8860ebc.source: Valley Park Middle School is a TDSB middle school serving grades 6–8 with about 1,100 students from the Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park communities, at 130 Overlea Blvd, East York. Its focus is a safe, supportive learning environment built on respect, responsibility, and safety; no French immersion, ESL, or special education programs were listed on the homepage text fetched.
6166d8860ebc.text: مدرسه متوسطه ولی پارک (Valley Park Middle School) یه مدرسه متوسطه TDSB است که برای پایه‌های ششم تا هشتم فعالیت می‌کنه و حدود 1,100 دانش‌آموز از محله‌های تورنکلیف پارک و فلمینگدون پارک رو پوشش میده. آدرسش 130 Overlea Blvd، ایست یورک است. تمرکز این مدرسه روی فراهم کردن یه محیط آموزشی امن و حمایتی است که بر پایه احترام، مسئولیت‌پذیری و ایمنی بنا شده؛ در متن صفحه اصلی که بررسی شد، هیچ برنامه‌ای برای آموزش فرانسوی (French immersion)، آموزش زبان انگلیسی (ESL) یا آموزش ویژه (special education) ذکر نشده بود.

62d55110cf7b.backTranslation: The free EarlyON Center for children and families, operated by TCDSB, is located at 175 Grenoble Dr and offers free play and learning programs (no registration required, but parental attendance is mandatory) for children aged 0 to 6 years along with their parents or caregivers. According to TCDSB schedules, the St. John XXIII Center operates from Monday to Thursday from 8:45 AM to 12:45 PM and on Fridays from 8:45 AM to 12:45 PM.
62d55110cf7b.source: Free TCDSB-run EarlyON Child and Family Centre at 175 Grenoble Dr offering drop-in play and learning programs for children ages 0-6 with their parents/caregivers (parent participation required, no registration needed). Per TCDSB schedules, St. John XXIII runs Monday-Thursday 8:45am-12:45pm and Friday 8:45am-12:45pm.
62d55110cf7b.text: مرکز رایگان EarlyON برای کودکان و خانواده‌ها که توسط TCDSB اداره می‌شود، در آدرس 175 Grenoble Dr واقع شده و برنامه‌های بازی و یادگیری آزاد (بدون نیاز به ثبت‌نام، اما با حضور والدین) را برای کودکان 0 تا 6 سال همراه با والدین یا مراقبانشان ارائه می‌دهد. طبق برنامه‌های TCDSB، مرکز St. John XXIII از دوشنبه تا پنجشنبه از ساعت 8:45 صبح تا 12:45 بعدازظهر و روز جمعه از ساعت 8:45 صبح تا 12:45 بعدازظهر فعال است.

63c710ddedbb.backTranslation: Nurses are available for 24-hour home care and all days of the week; no dedicated emergency service is mentioned (this center is not 911 or an urgent care provider).
63c710ddedbb.source: Nurses available 24/7 for home care needs; no dedicated emergency service listed (not a 911 or urgent-care provider).
63c710ddedbb.text: پرستاران برای مراقبت‌های خانگی 24 ساعته و در تمام روزهای هفته در دسترس هستند؛ هیچ سرویس اضطراری اختصاصی ذکر نشده است (این مرکز 911 یا ارائه‌دهنده خدمات مراقبت‌های فوری نیست).

problems: Name of the mosque is incorrect: 'Darul Salam Mosque' instead of 'Masjid Darus Salaam'.
Minor spelling variation in 'Jummah' vs 'Jumu'ah', but both are widely accepted.
67d4ed5dfe5d.backTranslation: Darul Salam Mosque at 20 Overlea Blvd has been serving the Muslim community of Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park and surrounding areas since 1995. The mosque offers five daily prayers and Jumu'ah prayers, full-time Hifz (complete memorization) and 'Alim/'Alima (scholar) courses, evening Quran classes (madrasa), Sunday school, Quran Tafsir and Islamic basics, youth programs, Nikah (marriage) services, and social events.
67d4ed5dfe5d.source: Masjid Darus Salaam at 20 Overlea Blvd, serving the Muslim community of Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park and beyond since 1995. Offers five daily prayers and Jummah, full-time Hifz and Alim/Alima programs, evening Quran classes (Madrasah), Sunday school, Tafseer and Islamic essentials studies, youth programs, Nikah services and community events.
67d4ed5dfe5d.text: مسجد دارالسلام در آدرس 20 Overlea Blvd، از سال 1995 تا حالا به جامعه مسلمانان تورنکلیف پارک، فلمینگدون پارک و مناطق اطراف خدمت می‌کند. این مسجد نمازهای پنج‌گانه روزانه و نماز جمعه، برنامه‌های حفظ قرآن (حفظ کامل) و دوره‌های علمی علما (Alim/Alima) به صورت تمام‌وقت، کلاس‌های قرآن عصرگاهی (مدرسه دینی)، مدرسه یکشنبه‌ها، تفسیر قرآن و مبانی اسلام، برنامه‌های ویژه جوانان، خدمات عقد و ازدواج (Nikah) و رویدادهای اجتماعی را ارائه می‌دهد.

problems: Wrong park name: 'Turncliff' instead of 'Thorncliffe'
Missing information: 'bazaar tables' is translated as 'market stalls', which changes the specific type of event
Minor addition: 'prepared by local businesses' is not in the original, though it does not significantly alter the meaning
68c635426ffe.backTranslation: The largest annual social event of "Turncliff" Park, which has been held in R.V. Burgess Park for the past 14 years. A summer afternoon and evening with hospitality, arts and crafts, music, dance, games, market stalls and food prepared by local businesses. This program is organized by an independent volunteer committee and every year about 100 young people participate as volunteers to strengthen their leadership skills.
68c635426ffe.source: Thorncliffe Park's biggest annual community event, held for the last 14 years in R.V. Burgess Park. A summer afternoon and evening with refreshments, arts and crafts, music, dance, games, bazaar tables, and food from local businesses. Organized by an independent volunteer committee; about 100 youth volunteer each year, building leadership skills.
68c635426ffe.text: بزرگترین رویداد سالانه اجتماعی پارک «تورنکلیف»، که در 14 سال گذشته در پارک R.V. Burgess برگزار شده است. یک بعدازظهر و شب تابستانی با پذیرایی، هنر و صنایع دستی، موسیقی، رقص، بازی‌ها، غرفه‌های بازار و غذاهای تهیه‌شده توسط کسب‌وکارهای محلی. این برنامه توسط یک کمیته داوطلبانه مستقل سازماندهی می‌شود و هر سال حدود 100 جوان به عنوان داوطلب شرکت می‌کنند تا مهارت‌های رهبری خود را تقویت کنند.

problems: Original mentions 'wellness counselling', back-translation specifies 'mental health counseling' (potentially misleading scope)
Original lists 'trades training', back-translation uses 'professional training' (different type of training implied)
Original includes 'care navigation', back-translation specifies 'navigation to health services' (narrower scope than original)
6b17dc8d3ad4.backTranslation: Free and confidential walk-in center for youth aged 12 to 25 in Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park (operated by East Toronto Health Partners, TNO – The Neighbourhood Organization, and Youth Wellness Hubs Ontario; no health card, family doctor, or referral required). Services: mental health counseling, substance use support, primary medical care, navigation to health services, peer support, employment services, professional training, food bank, housing and settlement assistance, education, recreational and social programs, leadership skill development, and volunteer opportunities.
6b17dc8d3ad4.source: Free, confidential walk-in-style hub for youth aged 12–25 in Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park (launched by East Toronto Health Partners, TNO – The Neighbourhood Organization, and Youth Wellness Hubs Ontario; no health card, family doctor or referral needed). Services: wellness counselling, substance use support, primary care, care navigation, peer support, employment services, trades training, food bank, housing and settlement help, education, recreation/social programs, leadership development and volunteer opportunities.
6b17dc8d3ad4.text: مرکز رایگان و محرمانه با سیستم مراجعه مستقیم (بدون نیاز به وقت قبلی) برای جوانان 12 تا 25 سال در تورنکلیف پارک و فلمینگدون پارک (توسط East Toronto Health Partners، TNO – The Neighbourhood Organization و Youth Wellness Hubs Ontario راه‌اندازی شده است؛ نیازی به کارت بیمه درمانی، پزشک خانواده یا معرفی‌نامه نیست). خدمات: مشاوره سلامت روان، حمایت در زمینه مصرف مواد، مراقبت‌های اولیه پزشکی، راهنمایی برای دریافت خدمات درمانی، حمایت همسالان، خدمات کاریابی، آموزش حرفه‌ای، بانک مواد غذایی، کمک برای مسکن و اسکان، آموزش، برنامه‌های تفریحی و اجتماعی، پرورش مهارت‌های رهبری و فرصت‌های داوطلبانه.

6ba3dd305d6e.backTranslation: unityhealth.to is the homepage of Unity Health Toronto; a parent network that includes St. Joseph's Health Centre (30 The Queensway, 416-530-6000), St. Michael's Hospital (30 Bond St., 416-360-4000), and Providence Healthcare (3276 St. Clair Ave. E., 416-285-3666). St. Michael's Kidney Care Centre at 45 Overlea Blvd. (416-867-3700) is a community-based, patient-focused blood dialysis (hemodialysis) center with 21 treatment stations, 6 home dialysis training stations, and 5 examination rooms; Unity's Multi-Care Kidney Clinic offers nephrology, nursing, nutrition, pharmacy, social work, and education on treatment methods to slow the progression of kidney disease, as well as peritoneal dialysis and home hemodialysis options for patients.
6ba3dd305d6e.source: unityhealth.to is the homepage for Unity Health Toronto, the parent network of St. Joseph's Health Centre (30 The Queensway, 416-530-6000), St. Michael's Hospital (30 Bond St., 416-360-4000) and Providence Healthcare (3276 St. Clair Ave. E., 416-285-3666). The St. Michael's Kidney Care Centre at 45 Overlea Blvd. (416-867-3700) is a patient-centred community satellite hemodialysis facility with 21 treatment stations, 6 home-dialysis training stations and 5 exam rooms; Unity's Multi-Care Kidney Clinic offers nephrology, nursing, dietitian, pharmacist, social worker and modality-education support to slow kidney disease progression, plus peritoneal and home hemodialysis options.
6ba3dd305d6e.text: unityhealth.to صفحه اصلی Unity Health Toronto است؛ شبکه مادری که St. Joseph's Health Centre (30 The Queensway, 416-530-6000)، St. Michael's Hospital (30 Bond St., 416-360-4000) و Providence Healthcare (3276 St. Clair Ave. E., 416-285-3666) را شامل می‌شود. مرکز مراقبت از کلیه St. Michael's در 45 Overlea Blvd. (416-867-3700) یک مرکز دیالیز خون (همودیالیز) وابسته به جامعه و متمرکز بر بیمار است که دارای 21 ایستگاه درمانی، 6 ایستگاه آموزش دیالیز در منزل و 5 اتاق معاینه می‌باشد؛ کلینیک کلیه Multi-Care متعلق به Unity، خدمات متخصص کلیه، پرستاری، تغذیه، داروسازی، مددکاری اجتماعی و آموزش روش‌های درمانی را برای کند کردن پیشرفت بیماری کلیه ارائه می‌دهد و گزینه‌های دیالیز صفاقی و دیالیز خون در منزل را نیز در اختیار بیماران قرار می‌دهد.

problems: 'Agencies' mistranslated as 'departments'

7482403a5dc6.backTranslation: A public drinking water access point, which is useful during extreme heat.
7482403a5dc6.source: Public drinking-water access point, relevant during extreme heat events.
7482403a5dc6.text: نقطه دسترسی به آب آشامیدنی عمومی، که در زمان گرمای شدید کاربرد دارد.

problems: 'Spaces' translated as 'places'

79db95729d8c.backTranslation: TDSB elementary school at 9 Grenoble Drive, serving over 960 students from kindergarten to grade six (approximately 93% of families have immigrated to Canada, and over 73 languages are spoken). On the school's homepage, no special programs such as the French Immersion program are mentioned.
79db95729d8c.source: TDSB elementary school at 9 Grenoble Drive serving over 960 students from Kindergarten to Grade 6 (about 93% of families have immigrated to Canada; 73+ languages spoken). No special programs such as French Immersion are mentioned on the school's homepage.
79db95729d8c.text: مکتب ابتدایی TDSB در آدرس 9 Grenoble Drive که به بیش از 960 دانش‌آموز از مهدکودک تا صنف ششم خدمات ارائه می‌دهد (حدود 93٪ خانواده‌ها به کانادا مهاجرت کرده‌اند و بیش از 73 زبان صحبت می‌شود). در صفحه اصلی مکتب هیچ برنامه ویژه‌ای مانند برنامه آموزش فرانسوی (French Immersion) ذکر نشده است.

7bd551d09cd0.backTranslation: In the parents' handbook, it is mentioned that there is a crisis management policy and parents can request it from the officials if needed; but no specific public services for emergencies in the community have been mentioned.
7bd551d09cd0.source: Parent handbook notes an Emergency Management Policy available on request from supervisors; no public emergency-specific community services listed.
7bd551d09cd0.text: در کتابچه راهنمای والدین ذکر شده که سیاست مدیریت بحران وجود دارد و والدین می‌توانند در صورت نیاز از مسئولان درخواست کنند؛ اما هیچ خدمات عمومی خاص برای مواقع اضطراری در جامعه ذکر نشده است.

problems: The back-translation mentions 'support for speech delays' instead of 'language-delay support', which could be misleading as it narrows the scope to speech-related issues only.
The back-translation adds 'individually tailored' to 'case management', which is not present in the original and could imply a level of customization not explicitly stated.
The back-translation changes 'Friday gym playtime' to 'play and activities in the gym on Fridays', which slightly alters the focus but does not significantly mislead.
7c53a90857c2.backTranslation: Free EarlyON Center for children and families, specifically for Toronto residents with children aged 0 to 6 and their parents or caregivers: child development support programs, supportive services for parents, school readiness programs, support for speech delays, and special needs services with case management (individually tailored). Main location: TNO-Thorncliffe Park Community Hub, 45 Overlea Blvd Unit 200 (Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM); play and activities in the gym on Fridays at Jenner Jean Marie Community Centre, 48 Thorncliffe Park Dr.
7c53a90857c2.source: Free EarlyON Child and Family Centre for City of Toronto residents with children ages 0-6 and their parents/caregivers: child development support programs, parent support services, school readiness programs, language-delay support, and special needs services with individual case management. Main location: TNO-Thorncliffe Park Community Hub, 45 Overlea Blvd Unit 200 (Mon-Fri 9am-5pm); Friday gym playtime at Jenner Jean Marie Community Centre, 48 Thorncliffe Park Dr.
7c53a90857c2.text: مرکز رایگان EarlyON برای کودکان و خانواده‌ها، مخصوص ساکنان شهر تورنتو که کودکان 0 تا 6 سال و والدین یا مراقبان آن‌ها را دارند: برنامه‌های حمایت از رشد کودک، خدمات حمایتی برای والدین، برنامه‌های آمادگی برای مدرسه، حمایت در مورد تأخیر در تکلم و خدمات نیازهای ویژه با مدیریت موردی (برای هر فرد به‌طور جداگانه). محل اصلی: TNO-Thorncliffe Park Community Hub, 45 Overlea Blvd Unit 200 (دوشنبه تا جمعه، ساعت 9 صبح تا 5 بعدازظهر)؛ بازی و فعالیت در سالن ورزشی روز جمعه در Jenner Jean Marie Community Centre, 48 Thorncliffe Park Dr.

problems: Red Apple Daycare is mistranslated as Red Apple Childcare, which could cause confusion for residents looking for specific services.
Settlement worker office is mistranslated as Immigration Settlement Worker office, which might mislead residents about the scope of services provided.
7d47cf9e0e64.backTranslation: Toronto Catholic District School Board elementary school (JK to Grade 8) located at 175 Grenoble Drive in Flemingdon Park, offering ESL, special education, and Empower Reading program support, as well as sports teams. The building also hosts Red Apple Childcare (before and after school care), a free EarlyON Child and Family Centre (programs for children from birth to 6 years and parents), and an Immigration Settlement Worker office to support newcomers.
7d47cf9e0e64.source: Toronto Catholic District School Board elementary school (JK to Grade 8) at 175 Grenoble Drive in Flemingdon Park, offering ESL, special education and Empower Reading supports plus sports teams. The building also houses Red Apple Daycare (before and after school care), a free EarlyON Child and Family Centre (programs for children birth to age 6 and parents), and a settlement worker office supporting newcomers.
7d47cf9e0e64.text: مدرسه ابتدایی هیئت مدیره مدارس کاتولیک تورنتو (از کلاس JK تا کلاس هشتم) در آدرس 175 گرینوبل درایو در فلمنگدون پارک واقع شده است، که خدمات ESL، آموزش ویژه و حمایت از برنامه Empower Reading را ارائه می دهد و همچنین دارای تیم های ورزشی است. این ساختمان همچنین میزبان مهد کودک رد اپل (مراقبت قبل و بعد از مدرسه)، مرکز رایگان EarlyON برای کودک و خانواده (برنامه ها برای کودکان از بدو تولد تا 6 سالگی و والدین) و دفتر کارمند امور مهاجرتی برای حمایت از مهاجران جدید است.

problems: The back-translation adds 'free food for the community' which is not explicitly stated in the original and could mislead residents about the nature of the food access services.
7d8fe058aabe.backTranslation: Dixon Hall Housing Services provides shelter and housing support for those who are homeless or in unstable housing situations, including help finding suitable housing, preventing eviction, managing budgets, stabilizing income, improving health, and follow-up support to stay housed. Heyworth House at 2714 Danforth Ave is one of their housing centers. The organization also operates neighborhood-level food access centers (free food for the community, food banks, and food skills programs).
7d8fe058aabe.source: Dixon Hall Housing Services provides shelter and housing supports for people experiencing homelessness or precariously housed: help finding adequate housing, eviction prevention, budgeting, income stabilization, health promotion, and follow-up supports to remain housed. Heyworth House (2714 Danforth Ave) is one of their housing sites. Also runs community food access sites (community meals, food banks, food skills programming).
7d8fe058aabe.text: خدمات مسکن «دیکسون هال» (Dixon Hall Housing Services) برای کسانی که بی‌خانمان هستند یا وضعیت سکونتشان ناپایدار است، سرپناه و حمایت‌های مسکن فراهم می‌کند؛ از جمله کمک برای پیدا کردن خانه مناسب، جلوگیری از تخلیه خانه، مدیریت بودجه، تثبیت درآمد، ارتقای سلامت و حمایت‌های پیگیری برای ماندن در خانه. «هی‌ورث هاوس» (Heyworth House) در آدرس 2714 Danforth Ave یکی از مراکز مسکن آن‌هاست. این سازمان همچنین مراکز دسترسی به غذا در سطح محله را اداره می‌کند (غذای رایگان برای جامعه، بانک‌های غذایی و برنامه‌های آموزش مهارت‌های غذایی).

problems: The term 'Collaboratives' is changed to 'collaborations', which could imply a different structure or nature of the organization or initiative.
The term 'social centers' does not accurately reflect the specific services and activities typically offered by 'Community Centres', which may mislead residents about the nature of the facilities.
The back-translation incorrectly states 'orphanage' instead of 'youth shelter', which could mislead residents about the type of facility.
85b8d1f0296e.backTranslation: runs an orphanage (emergency shelter) for homeless youth.
85b8d1f0296e.source: Operates a youth shelter for youth experiencing homelessness (emergency shelter).
85b8d1f0296e.text: برای جوانان بی‌خانمان یتیم‌خانه (پناهگاه اضطراری) اداره می‌کند.

problems: The back-translation uses 'PA days' instead of 'PD days', which could cause confusion for residents unfamiliar with the abbreviation.
The back-translation adds 'full-year operation' for 206 Laird Dr, which is not present in the original and is redundant since 'year-round' is already mentioned.
The back-translation omits 'Kids Club' for the before/after-school program at 31 Rolph Rd, which is a specific name that residents might recognize.
88f8e20033ec.backTranslation: A licensed childcare center operating at three locations: 206 Laird Dr (infants, toddlers, preschool, full-year operation), 31 Rolph Rd at Rolph Road School (preschool, kindergarten, school-age children; before and after-school club for kindergarten to grade 6 with homework assistance, snack, and full coverage on PA days, Christmas, and March breaks), and 182 Bessborough Dr at St. Anselm School (kindergarten, school-age children). Also offers summer camp (music, dance, sports, swimming, arts and crafts) in July and August. The center participates in the CWELCC fee reduction program.
88f8e20033ec.source: Licensed childcare with three sites: 206 Laird Dr (infants, toddlers, preschool, year-round), 31 Rolph Rd at Rolph Road School (preschool, kindergarten, school-age; before/after-school Kids Club for JK-Grade 6 with homework help, snacks, plus full-day PD day/Christmas/March break coverage), and 182 Bessborough Dr at St. Anselm School (kindergarten, school-age). Also runs a July-August summer camp (music, dance, sports, swimming, arts & crafts). Participates in CWELCC fee reduction.
88f8e20033ec.text: مرکز مراقبت از کودکان دارای مجوز که در سه مکان فعالیت می‌کند: 206 Laird Dr (نوزادان، کودکان نوپا، پیش‌دبستانی، فعالیت در تمام طول سال)، 31 Rolph Rd در مدرسه Rolph Road (پیش‌دبستانی، مهدکودک، کودکان در سن مدرسه؛ باشگاه کودکان قبل و بعد از مدرسه برای مهدکودک تا کلاس ششم با کمک در تکالیف، میان‌وعده و پوشش کامل روزهای تعطیل آموزشی، کریسمس و تعطیلات اسفند/حمل)، و 182 Bessborough Dr در مدرسه St. Anselm (مهدکودک، کودکان در سن مدرسه). همچنین در ماه‌های جولای و آگوست اردوی تابستانی (موسیقی، رقص، ورزش، شنا، هنر و صنایع دستی) برگزار می‌کند. این مرکز در برنامه کاهش شهریه CWELCC شرکت دارد.

problems: The back-translation 'Mozimonah' does not match or resemble the original term 'Museums', which could mislead residents searching for cultural institutions.

8d4903274832.backTranslation: Core 911 Emergency Services: Fire suppression, rescue, and medical first aid. Call 911 in case of emergency.
8d4903274832.source: Core 911 emergency response: fire suppression, rescue, and medical first response. Call 911 in an emergency.
8d4903274832.text: خدمات اضطراری Core 911: خاموش کردن آتش، نجات و کمک‌های اولیه پزشکی. در مواقع اضطراری با شماره 911 تماس بگیرید.

8f3b8610ff41.backTranslation: The provincial government service office is located at 945 Eglinton Ave East (inside Staples). This office issues driver's licenses, vehicle registration and plates, Ontario health cards, and birth certificates. The hours of operation are Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
8f3b8610ff41.source: Provincial government services office at 945 Eglinton Avenue East (inside Staples). Issues driver's licences, vehicle registration and plates, Ontario health cards and birth certificates. Open Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
8f3b8610ff41.text: دفتر خدمات دولتی استان در 945 ایگلینتون اونو ایست (داخل استیپلز) واقع است. این دفتر گواهینامه رانندگی، ثبت نام خودرو و پلاک، کارت های بهداشتی انتاریو و گواهی تولد صادر می کند. ساعات کار از دوشنبه تا جمعه از ساعت 9:00 صبح تا 9:00 شب و روز شنبه از ساعت 9:00 صبح تا 5:00 بعد از ظهر است.

problems: Original states the centre is 'public', back-translation adds 'government-funded' and 'owned by the City of Toronto' which are not in the original.
Original states 'Dennis R. Timbrell Resource Centre', back-translation has 'Dennis R. Timberl Resource Centre' (misspelled surname).
912f65f2191e.backTranslation: Flemingdon Early Learning & Child Care Centre (29 St Dennis Dr, Don Mills/Eglinton; contact Latoya Wilson-Rose: 416-392-3170) is a licensed, government-funded child care center owned by the City of Toronto, serving children aged 0 to 4 years, located within the Dennis R. Timberl Resource Centre. This center participates in the Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care (CWELCC) system, and fee subsidies are available; staff speak 9 languages including Arabic, Bengali, French, Hindi, and Persian, and meals are externally catered with halal, pork-free, peanut-free, vegan, and vegetarian options available.
912f65f2191e.source: Flemingdon Early Learning & Child Care Centre (29 St Dennis Dr, Don Mills/Eglinton; contact Latoya Wilson-Rose, 416-392-3170) is a public, licensed City of Toronto child care centre serving children 0 to 4 years, located in the Dennis R. Timbrell Resource Centre. It participates in the Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care (CWELCC) system with fee subsidies available; staff speak 9 languages including Arabic, Bengali, French, Hindi, and Persian, and meals are catered with halal, pork-free, peanut-free, vegan, and vegetarian options available.
