912f65f2191e.text: مرکز یادگیری اولیه و مراقبت از کودکان فلمینگدون (Flemingdon Early Learning & Child Care Centre, 29 St Dennis Dr, Don Mills/Eglinton؛ با لاتویا ویلسون-رز تماس بگیرید: 416-392-3170) یه مرکز مراقبت از کودکان مجاز و دولتی متعلق به شهر تورنتو است که به کودکان 0 تا 4 سال خدمات می‌دهد و در مرکز منابع دنیس آر. تیمبرل واقع شده است. این مرکز در سیستم یادگیری اولیه و مراقبت از کودکان در سراسر کانادا (CWELCC) شرکت می‌کند و کمک‌هزینه شهریه در آن موجود است؛ کارکنان به 9 زبان از جمله عربی، بنگالی، فرانسوی، هندی و فارسی صحبت می‌کنند و غذاها به صورت بیرونی تهیه می‌شوند و گزینه‌های حلال، بدون گوشت خوک، بدون بادام‌زمینی، گیاهی (وگان) و سبزیجات در دسترس هستند.

9229c66e10d7.backTranslation: A large public park adjacent to Thorncliffe Park that includes an 18-hole disc golf course, a public archery range, running and cycling trails, nature trails, picnic shelters and fire pits. The water fountain provides free drinking water (seasonal; closed in winter).
9229c66e10d7.source: Large public park adjoining Thorncliffe Park with an 18-hole disc golf course, a public archery range, jogging and cycling paths, nature trails, picnic shelters and fire pits. The drinking fountain provides free drinking water (seasonal; closed in winter).
9229c66e10d7.text: پارک بزرگ عمومی که به پارک تورن‌کلیف چسبیده و شامل زمین دیس‌گلف با 18 حفره، میدان تیراندازی با کمان عمومی، مسیرهای دویدن و دوچرخه‌سواری، مسیرهای طبیعت‌گردی، سایه‌بان‌های پیک‌نیک و جای آتش است. آب‌نما آب آشامیدنی رایگان فراهم می‌کند (فصلی؛ در زمستان بسته است).

problems: The back-translation 'Strengthening neighbors and individuals' changes the meaning from 'empowerment' to 'strengthening', which could imply a different approach or focus.

941791890d5c.backTranslation: Gateway Public School is a TDSB-run elementary school serving grades from preschool to 6th grade (approximately 950 students) in Flemingdon Park, located at 55 Gateway Blvd, North York. The school emphasizes an inclusive, multicultural learning environment with high expectations for academic achievement and behavior; in the reviewed homepage text, no programs for French immersion, English as a Second Language (ESL), or special education were mentioned.
941791890d5c.source: Gateway Public School is a TDSB elementary school serving Junior Kindergarten to Grade 6 (approx. 950 students) in Flemingdon Park, at 55 Gateway Blvd, North York. The school emphasizes an inclusive, multicultural learning environment with high expectations for achievement and conduct; no French immersion, ESL, or special education programs were listed on the homepage text fetched.
941791890d5c.text: مدرسه دولتی Gateway یه مدرسه ابتدایی تحت مدیریت TDSB است که از مقطع پیش‌دبستانی تا کلاس ششم (حدود 950 دانش‌آموز) رو در Flemingdon Park، به آدرس 55 Gateway Blvd, North York پوشش می‌ده. این مدرسه روی یه محیط آموزشی فراگیر و چندفرهنگی با انتظارات بالا از نظر پیشرفت تحصیلی و رفتار تأکید داره؛ در متن صفحه اصلی که بررسی شد، هیچ برنامه‌ای برای آموزش زبان فرانسوی (French immersion)، آموزش زبان انگلیسی (ESL) یا آموزش ویژه (special education) ذکر نشده بود.

95c8c42be839.backTranslation: The Toronto Public Library branch is located at 48 Thorncliffe Park Drive. This library offers book lending services, free Wi-Fi, public computers equipped with Microsoft Office, printing, copying, and scanning services, a children's early literacy center (KidsStop), a youth activity center (Youth Hub), an individual reading assistance program for children (Leading to Reading), information services for newcomers, financial empowerment services, reservable meeting rooms, and a quiet study space.
95c8c42be839.source: Toronto Public Library branch at 48 Thorncliffe Park Drive. Offers book borrowing, free Wi-Fi, public computers with Microsoft Office, print/copy/scan, a KidsStop early literacy centre, Youth Hub, Leading to Reading one-to-one children's reading help, a Newcomer Information Service, a Financial Empowerment Service, a bookable meeting room and quiet study space.
95c8c42be839.text: شعبه کتابخانه عمومی تورنتو در آدرس 48 Thorncliffe Park Drive واقع شده است. این کتابخانه خدمات امانت کتاب، وای‌فای رایگان، کامپیوترهای عمومی مجهز به Microsoft Office، خدمات چاپ، کپی و اسکن، مرکز سوادآموزی اولیه کودکان (KidsStop)، مرکز فعالیت‌های جوانان (Youth Hub)، برنامه کمک انفرادی به کودکان برای یادگیری خواندن (Leading to Reading)، خدمات اطلاعاتی برای تازه‌واردان، خدمات توانمندسازی مالی، اتاق جلسات قابل رزرو و فضای مطالعه آرام را ارائه می‌دهد.

problems: Missing 'inquiry-driven learning' from the back-translation
97522b6e2a71.backTranslation: Licensed childcare centers in the neighborhood offering infant, toddler, preschool, and before/after school programs. These centers feature play-based learning, nutritious meals (accommodating allergies, cultural/religious diets), and secure entry systems. Addresses: 175 Grenoble Dr (Grenoble) and 135 Overlea Blvd (Overlea).
97522b6e2a71.source: Licensed childcare centres in the neighbourhood offering infant, toddler, preschool, and before/after-school programs with play-based, inquiry-driven learning, nutritious meals (accommodating allergies and cultural/religious diets), and secure entry systems. Locations: 175 Grenoble Dr (Grenoble) and 135 Overlea Blvd (Overlea).
97522b6e2a71.text: مراکز مراقبت از کودکان دارای جواز در همسایگی که خدمات نگهداری از نوزادان، کودکان نوپا و برنامه‌های پیش‌دبستانی و قبل و بعد از مدرسه رو ارائه می‌کنن. این مراکز یادگیری مبتنی بر بازی و کاوش، غذاهای مقوی (با در نظر گرفتن حساسیت‌های غذایی و رژیم‌های فرهنگی و مذهبی) و سیستم‌های ورود امن دارن. نشانی‌ها: 175 Grenoble Dr (Grenoble) و 135 Overlea Blvd (Overlea).

97e9202b1cb6.backTranslation: Local bike hub on Gateway Blvd run by TNO. Offers free bike repair (by appointment), DIY repair hours with tools and space, bike mechanic workshops, learn-to-ride classes, and group rides. Bikes available through Earn-a-Bike program, twice-yearly bike giveaways, and bike request form.
97e9202b1cb6.source: Community bike hub on Gateway Blvd run by TNO. Offers free bike repairs (bookable appointments), do-it-yourself repair hours with tools and space, bike mechanics workshops, learn-to-ride lessons and group rides. Bikes available via the Earn-a-Bike program, twice-yearly bike giveaways, and an apply-for-a-bike option.
97e9202b1cb6.text: مرکز دوچرخه‌های محلی در Gateway Blvd که توسط TNO اداره می‌شود. تعمیر رایگان دوچرخه (با تعیین وقت قبلی)، ساعات تعمیر شخصی با ابزار و فضا، کارگاه‌های آموزش مکانیکی دوچرخه، کلاس‌های یادگیری راندن دوچرخه و دوچرخه‌سواری‌های گروهی ارائه می‌دهد. دوچرخه‌ها از طریق برنامه Earn-a-Bike، اهدای دوچرخه دو بار در سال و امکان درخواست دوچرخه در دسترس هستند.

99a408333e20.backTranslation: Mosques in the Flemingdon Park area (established 2001, capacity 250-300 worshippers) that holds five daily congregational prayers and Friday prayers. The mosque provides Islamic education and guidance for children and adults and welcomes Muslim and non-Muslim visitors.
99a408333e20.source: Mosque in the Flemingdon Park area (established 2001, holds 250-300 worshippers) offering five daily congregational prayers and Jummah Salah. Provides Islamic education and guidance for children and adults, and welcomes both Muslim and non-Muslim visitors.
99a408333e20.text: مسجد در منطقه فلمینگدون پارک (تأسیس 2001، گنجایش 250 تا 300 نمازگزار) که پنج نماز جماعت روزانه و نماز جمعه را برگزار می‌کند. این مسجد آموزش و راهنمایی‌های اسلامی برای کودکان و بزرگسالان ارائه می‌دهد و از بازدیدکنندگان مسلمان و غیرمسلمان استقبال می‌کند.

9aab0433db11.backTranslation: A park with a bottle-filling station that fills drinking water for free.
9aab0433db11.source: Neighbourhood park featuring a bottle filling station providing free drinking water refills.
9aab0433db11.text: پارک محل که یه دستگاه پرکن بطری داره و آب آشامیدنی رو رایگان پر می‌کنه.

problems: The term 'Platinum Ecoschool' was mistranslated to 'Platinum Green School', which could cause confusion about the specific recognition the school has received.
a1893ed621a6.backTranslation: The TDSB public elementary school located at 80 Thorncliffe Park Dr is known as a "Platinum Green School" and has an active environmental club. This school, in collaboration with students, families, and the community, provides public educational services.
a1893ed621a6.source: TDSB public elementary school at 80 Thorncliffe Park Dr, recognized as a Platinum Ecoschool with an active eco club. Provides public education in partnership with students, families and the community.
a1893ed621a6.text: مکتب ابتدایی دولتی TDSB در آدرس 80 Thorncliffe Park Dr واقع شده است؛ این مکتب به عنوان «مکتب سبز پلاتینیوم» شناخته می‌شود و باشگاه محیط‌زیستی فعالی دارد. این مکتب در همکاری با دانش‌آموزان، خانواده‌ها و جامعه، خدمات آموزشی دولتی ارائه می‌دهد.

a3d76b624b59.backTranslation: The urban agriculture group at Thorncliffe Park that maintains two public vegetable gardens and over 20 fruit trees and shares all produce freely with residents and volunteers. The group runs environmental education programs, nature programs for children, youth leadership programs and volunteer hours, a resident-managed composting program, pollinator habitats, and carpentry and art workshops.
a3d76b624b59.source: Community urban-farming group in Thorncliffe Park maintaining two communal vegetable gardens and 20+ fruit trees, with all harvests shared freely with residents and volunteers. Runs environmental education, children's nature programs, youth leadership and volunteer hours, a resident-led composting program, pollinator habitats, and woodworking and art workshops.
a3d76b624b59.text: گروه کشاورزی شهری در تورن‌کلیف پارک که دو باغ سبزیجات عمومی و بیش از 20 اصله درخت میوه را نگهداری می‌کند و تمام محصولات را به صورت رایگان با ساکنان و داوطلبان تقسیم می‌نماید. این گروه برنامه‌های آموزش محیط‌زیست، برنامه‌های طبیعت برای کودکان، برنامه‌های رهبری جوانان و ساعات داوطلبانه، برنامه کمپوست‌سازی به مدیریت ساکنان، زیستگاه‌های گرده‌افشانان و کارگاه‌های نجاری و هنر را برگزار می‌کند.

a44c76defc5c.backTranslation: The Thorncliffe Park Daycare Center has been serving families since 1969 and offers play-based educational programs for children from birth to 12 years old, including school-age programs, based on the "How Does Learning Happen" framework. The staff speaks 11 languages (including Urdu, Farsi, Punjabi, Bengali, Amharic, Tagalog, and Turkish). Meals are provided by Real Food For Real Kids, and the center participates in the CWELCC program; information about tuition subsidies is also available.
a44c76defc5c.source: Thorncliffe Park Day Care Centre has served families since 1969 with play-based educational programs for children from infancy through 12 years old, including school-age programs, following the 'How Does Learning Happen' framework. Staff speak 11 languages (including Urdu, Farsi, Punjabi, Bengali, Amharic, Tagalog, Turkish), meals are provided through the Real Food For Real Kids catering, and the centre participates in CWELCC with fee subsidy information available.
a44c76defc5c.text: مرکز مراقبت روزانه تورن‌کلیف پارک از سال 1969 تا حالا به خانواده‌ها خدمت می‌کند و برنامه‌های آموزشی مبتنی بر بازی را برای کودکان از بدو تولد تا 12 سالگی، شامل برنامه‌های مخصوص سنین مدرسه، بر اساس چارچوب «آموزش چگونه اتفاق می‌افتد» ارائه می‌دهد. کارکنان این مرکز به 11 زبان (از جمله اردو، فارسی، پنجابی، بنگالی، آمهری، تاگالوگ و ترکی) صحبت می‌کنند. غذاها توسط Real Food For Real Kids تهیه می‌شوند و این مرکز در برنامه CWELCC شرکت دارد؛ اطلاعات مربوط به یارانه شهریه نیز در دسترس است.

a583aca46f5e.backTranslation: Toronto Public Library branch at 29 St. Dennis Drive: book lending, public computers, children's programs, Leading to Reading literacy program for kids, and free financial empowerment services (filing tax returns, applying for benefits, and assistance with budgeting—these services are also available at the Thorncliffe branch). Posted hours of operation: Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 8:30 PM, Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM, and Sunday from 12 PM to 5 PM. Note: This branch will be closed from December 1, 2025, due to a renovation and revitalization project and is expected to reopen in the early third quarter of 2026; although it is listed as open in the current hours of operation, be sure to check before visiting.
a583aca46f5e.source: Toronto Public Library branch at 29 St. Dennis Drive: book borrowing, public computers, children's programs, Leading to Reading literacy program for kids, and the free Financial Empowerment Service (tax filing, benefits applications, budgeting help — also offered at Thorncliffe branch). Listed hours: Mon-Fri 9am-8:30pm, Sat 9am-5pm, Sun 12-5pm. Note: the branch closed Dec 1, 2025 for a refresh project with reopening expected early Q3 2026; current hours listing suggests it has reopened, but verify before visiting.
a583aca46f5e.text: شعبه کتابخانه عمومی تورنتو در آدرس 29 St. Dennis Drive: امانت کتاب، کامپیوترهای عمومی، برنامه‌های کودکان، برنامه سوادآموزی Leading to Reading برای بچه‌ها و خدمات رایگان توانمندسازی مالی (اعلام درآمد مالیاتی، درخواست مزایا و کمک در مدیریت بودجه — این خدمات در شعبه Thorncliffe هم ارائه می‌شود). ساعات کاری اعلام شده: دوشنبه تا جمعه از ساعت 9 صبح تا 8:30 شب، شنبه از ساعت 9 صبح تا 5 عصر و یکشنبه از ساعت 12 تا 5 عصر. توجه: این شعبه از تاریخ 1 دسامبر 2025 به دلیل پروژه بازسازی و نوسازی بسته خواهد شد و انتظار می‌رود اوایل سه‌ماهه سوم سال 2026 دوباره باز شود؛ اگرچه در لیست ساعات کاری فعلی باز بودن آن ذکر شده، اما قبل از مراجعه حتماً بررسی کنید.

a5c931e58836.backTranslation: The TNO Food Collaborative program (run by The Neighbourhood Organization) provides free access to food for thousands in the Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park neighborhoods; including fresh fruits and vegetables, eggs, and dairy products that are distributed twice a month, and the distribution of these items is supported throughout the year by local partners such as Greenwin Cares.
a5c931e58836.source: The TNO Food Collaborative (run by The Neighbourhood Organization) provides free food access to thousands of individuals in the Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park communities, including fresh produce, eggs, and dairy products distributed twice a month, with year-round distribution supported by community partners like Greenwin Cares.
a5c931e58836.text: برنامه TNO Food Collaborative (که توسط The Neighbourhood Organization اداره می‌شود) برای هزاران نفر در محله‌های Thorncliffe Park و Flemingdon Park دسترسی رایگان به مواد غذایی فراهم می‌کند؛ از جمله میوه‌ها و سبزیجات تازه، تخم‌مرغ و محصولات لبنی که دو بار در ماه توزیع می‌شوند و توزیع این مواد در تمام طول سال با حمایت شرکای محلی مانند Greenwin Cares انجام می‌گردد.

aa052d1c9356.backTranslation: TDSB public high school (grades 9 to 12) at 135 Overlea Blvd serving the Flemingdon Park and Thorncliffe Park neighbourhoods (approx. 1800 students). The school hosts the TOPS program (Talented Offerings for Programs in Science); a four-year enriched program in math, science and English with AP level courses; as well as SHSM programs, horticulture, financial securities, ESL supports, over 90 student clubs and competitive team sports.
aa052d1c9356.source: TDSB public high school (grades 9-12) at 135 Overlea Blvd serving Flemingdon Park and Thorncliffe Park (~1800 students). Host school of the TOPS program (Talented Offerings for Programs in the Sciences), a four-year enriched math/science/English program with AP-level courses; also offers SHSM, horticulture, financial securities programs, ESL supports, 90+ student-led clubs and competitive team sports.
aa052d1c9356.text: مدرسه لیسه دولتی TDSB (پایه‌های نهم تا دوازدهم) در آدرس 135 Overlea Blvd که به محله‌های Flemingdon Park و Thorncliffe Park خدمات می‌دهد (حدود 1800 دانش‌آموز). این مدرسه میزبان برنامه TOPS (فرصت‌های ویژه برای برنامه‌های علوم) است؛ یک برنامه چهارساله تقویت‌شده در ریاضی، علوم و انگلیسی با دروس سطح AP؛ همچنین برنامه‌های SHSM، باغداری، اوراق بهادار مالی، حمایت‌های ESL، بیش از 90 باشگاه دانش‌آموزی و ورزش‌های تیمی رقابتی را ارائه می‌دهد.

problems: The back-translation 'Police shell' completely changes the meaning and purpose of the original 'Police Station', which could mislead residents about the location and services provided.

ae69792878f8.backTranslation: Chapel in the Park United is a small, multicultural congregation located at 16 Thorncliffe Park Drive, Toronto (416-421-0792), serving the residents of Thorncliffe Park and Don Mills. The church holds services every Sunday at 10:00 a.m., both in-person, via Zoom, and live-streamed, inviting newcomers to join as a "faith family."
ae69792878f8.source: Chapel in the Park United Church is a small multicultural congregation at 16 Thorncliffe Park Drive, Toronto (416-421-0792), serving Thorncliffe Park and Don Mills. It holds Sunday services at 10:00 a.m. in person, via Zoom, and live stream, and invites newcomers to join as a 'faith family.'
ae69792878f8.text: کلیسای Chapel in the Park United یک گروه کوچک و چندفرهنگی است که در آدرس 16 Thorncliffe Park Drive، تورنتو (416-421-0792) واقع شده و به ساکنان Thorncliffe Park و Don Mills خدمات ارائه می‌دهد. این کلیسا هر یکشنبه ساعت 10:00 صبح مراسم برگزار می‌کند که هم به صورت حضوری، هم از طریق Zoom و هم به صورت پخش زنده است و از تازه‌واردان دعوت می‌کند تا به عنوان «خانواده‌ای ایمان‌دار» به آن بپیوندند.

problems: 'Child Services' changed to 'Children Services'
The back-translation uses 'light sports' instead of 'low-impact exercise', which could mislead residents about the type of physical activity offered.
b8138c775adf.backTranslation: Free settlement services for refugees and immigrants, with a special focus on women and families: LINC English classes for women, translation and interpretation services, support for finding employment, basic and advanced computer classes, English conversation groups, sewing club, drop-in center for youth, and light sports. All programs are free and offered both in-person and online (call to book an appointment).
b8138c775adf.source: Free settlement services for refugees and immigrants, with a special focus on women and families: women-only LINC English classes, translation and interpretation services, employment support, basic and advanced computer classes, English conversation circles, sewing club, youth drop-in, and low-impact exercise. All programs are free, offered onsite and online (call for an appointment).
b8138c775adf.text: خدمات رایگان اسکان برای پناهندگان و مهاجران، با تمرکز ویژه بر زنان و خانواده‌ها: کلاس‌های زبان انگلیسی LINC مخصوص زنان، خدمات ترجمه و تفسیر، حمایت برای یافتن کار، کلاس‌های مقدماتی و پیشرفته کامپیوتر، گروه‌های گفتگو به زبان انگلیسی، باشگاه خیاطی، مرکز حضور آزاد برای جوانان و ورزش‌های سبک. تمام برنامه‌ها رایگان هستند و هم به صورت حضوری و هم آنلاین ارائه می‌شوند (برای تعیین وقت تماس بگیرید).

problems: The back-translation mentions 'school-based pediatric clinics' (plural) instead of 'a school-based pediatric clinic' (singular), which could imply multiple clinics when there is only one.
The back-translation adds 'accommodation' to the list of referrals, which is not mentioned in the original text.
The back-translation uses 'financial support programs' instead of 'income support,' which could be misleading as it may imply a broader range of financial assistance than what is offered.
b9bf5f163902.backTranslation: Primary and comprehensive health care for free for residents of the M4H postal area, without the need for a health card or referral, along with interpreter services. Services include ongoing primary care, school-based pediatric clinics, foot care for the elderly and people with chronic diseases, nutrition counseling, social work services and mental health counseling, health education workshops, family support and referrals to financial support programs, accommodation, housing, employment and language training. This center is located at Thorncliffe Park Community Hub, 45 Overlea Blvd, 2nd floor.
b9bf5f163902.source: Free comprehensive primary health care for residents of the M4H postal code, no health card or referral needed, with interpretation services. Services include ongoing primary care, a school-based pediatric clinic, foot care for seniors and people with chronic conditions, nutrition counselling, social work and mental health counselling, health education workshops, family support, and referrals to income support, settlement, housing, employment and language programs. Located in the Thorncliffe Park Community Hub, 45 Overlea Blvd, 2nd Floor.
b9bf5f163902.text: مراقبت‌های صحی اولیه و جامع به صورت رایگان برای ساکنان منطقه پستی M4H، بدون نیاز به کارت صحی یا معرفی‌نامه، همراه با خدمات ترجمان. خدمات شامل مراقبت‌های اولیه مستمر، کلینیک اطفال در مدارس، مراقبت از پاها برای سالمندان و افراد مبتلا به بیماری‌های مزمن، مشاوره تغذیه، خدمات مددکاری اجتماعی و مشاوره سلامت روان، کارگاه‌های آموزشی بهداشتی، حمایت از خانواده و معرفی به برنامه‌های حمایت مالی، اسکان، مسکن، اشتغال و آموزش زبان است. این مرکز در Thorncliffe Park Community Hub، واقع در 45 Overlea Blvd، طبقه دوم قرار دارد.

ba5f23dbc690.backTranslation: Free EarlyON Centre programs for children and families, held by Family Day, are for parents and caregivers of young children. These programs support early learning, child development, and positive parent-child interactions through indoor, outdoor, and virtual activities. The Flemingdon Park Centre is located at 150 Grenoble Drive (Don Mills/Overlea); on the same page, the Grenoble EarlyON Centre is also mentioned.
ba5f23dbc690.source: Free EarlyON Child and Family Centre programs run by Family Day for parents and caregivers with young children, supporting early learning, child development and positive parent-child interaction through indoor, outdoor and virtual programming. The Flemingdon Park centre is at 150 Grenoble Drive (Don Mills/Overlea); the same page also lists a Grenoble EarlyON site.
ba5f23dbc690.text: برنامه‌های رایگان مرکز EarlyON برای کودکان و خانواده‌ها که توسط Family Day برگزار می‌شوند، برای والدین و مراقبان کودکان خردسال است. این برنامه‌ها از طریق فعالیت‌های داخل سالن، فضای باز و مجازی، یادگیری اولیه، رشد کودک و تعامل مثبت بین والدین و کودکان را حمایت می‌کنند. مرکز فلیمینگدون پارک در آدرس 150 Grenoble Drive (Don Mills/Overlea) واقع شده است؛ در همان صفحه، مرکز EarlyON گرونبل نیز ذکر شده است.

problems: 'engaging' mistranslated as 'attractive'
baf809656cc3.backTranslation: A group of neighbors working to create accessible, attractive, and inclusive public spaces for everyone to enjoy in Thorncliffe Park.
baf809656cc3.source: A group of neighbours working to create accessible, engaging, and inclusive public spaces for everyone to enjoy in Thorncliffe Park.
baf809656cc3.text: یک گروه از همسایه‌ها که برای ساختن فضاهای عمومی در دسترس، جذاب و فراگیر کار می‌کنند تا همه در تورن‌کلیف پارک از آن‌ها لذت ببرند.

problems: Time format change from '9am–1pm' to '9 to 13' and '4pm–7pm' to '16 to 19' could mislead residents unfamiliar with 24-hour time.
bc208860cefc.backTranslation: Toronto Hifz Academy at 45 Overlea Blvd, Unit 201, Toronto (M4H 1C3; 647-505-8622) is a Quranic school that offers full-time and part-time hifz programs, pre-hifz, hifz revision, classical Arabic language, and Quran classes for sisters. Classes are held Monday to Thursday from 9 to 13 and 16 to 19, and on Fridays from 9 to 14 and 16 to 19.
bc208860cefc.source: Toronto Hifz Academy at 45 Overlea Blvd, Unit 201, Toronto (M4H 1C3; 647-505-8622) is a Quranic school offering Full-Time and Part-Time Hifz (Quran memorization), Pre-Hifz, Hafiz review, Classical Arabic, and Sisters Quran classes. Classes run Mon–Thu 9am–1pm and 4pm–7pm, and Fri 9am–2pm and 4pm–7pm.
bc208860cefc.text: آکادمی حفظ تورنتو در آدرس 45 Overlea Blvd, Unit 201, Toronto (M4H 1C3; 647-505-8622) یه مدرسه قرآنیه که دوره‌های حفظ قرآن تمام‌وقت و پاره‌وقت، پیش‌حفظ، مرور حفظ، زبان عربی کلاسیک و کلاس‌های قرآن مخصوص خواهران رو ارائه می‌کنه. کلاس‌ها از دوشنبه تا پنجشنبه از ساعت 9 تا 13 و 16 تا 19 و روز جمعه از ساعت 9 تا 14 و 16 تا 19 برگزار میشن.

problems: Park name is misspelled as 'Lizside' instead of 'Leaside'
Street name 'Overlea Boulevard' is incorrectly translated as 'Orillia Boulevard'
c04bdbce2472.backTranslation: Lizside Park (near Millwood Road and Orillia Boulevard) provides public drinking water through a fountain and two bottle filling stations. The 3.4-hectare park also has a baseball diamond with lights, six tennis courts with lights, a multi-purpose sports field, a children's playground, a community garden, washrooms, and the Lizside outdoor pool.
c04bdbce2472.source: Leaside Park (near Millwood Road and Overlea Boulevard) provides public drinking water through 1 drinking fountain and 2 bottle filling stations. The 3.4-hectare park also has a lit ball diamond, six lit tennis courts, a multipurpose sports field, a children's playground, a community garden, washrooms and the Leaside Outdoor Pool.
c04bdbce2472.text: پارک لیزاید (نزدیک جاده میل‌وود و بلوار اورلیا) از طریق یه آب‌نما و دو ایستگاه پرکردن بطری، آب آشامیدنی عمومی فراهم می‌کنه. این پارک به مساحت 3.4 هکتار، یه زمین بیسبال با نورافکن، شش زمین تنیس با نورافکن، یه زمین ورزشی چندمنظوره، یه زمین بازی کودکان، یه باغ اجتماعی، سرویس‌های بهداشتی و استخر روباز لیزاید رو هم داره.

c0b5b18276a1.backTranslation: The local food bank at 10 Gateway Blvd (basement), North York, which provides free food and essential items to needy families, is now registered as a charity. The working hours are listed differently on the website (Monday and Wednesday from 11:00 to 3:30 in one section, and Monday to Thursday from 1:30 to 3:30 in another section); call 416-422-4322 before visiting to confirm.
c0b5b18276a1.source: Community food bank at 10 Gateway Blvd (basement), North York, providing free food and resources to families in need; now a registered charity. The site lists inconsistent hours (Mondays and Wednesdays 11:00am-3:30pm in one place, Mon-Thu 1:30-3:30pm in another) - call 416-422-4322 to confirm before visiting.
c0b5b18276a1.text: بانک غذایی محلی در آدرس 10 Gateway Blvd (زیرزمین)، نورث یورک، که به خانواده‌های نیازمند غذا و وسایل ضروری رایگان می‌دهد؛ حالا به عنوان یک مؤسسه خیریه ثبت شده است. ساعات کاری در وب‌سایت به‌طور متفاوتی ذکر شده (دوشنبه و چهارشنبه از ساعت 11:00 تا 3:30 در یک بخش، و از دوشنبه تا پنجشنبه از ساعت 1:30 تا 3:30 در بخش دیگر)؛ قبل از مراجعه برای اطمینان با شماره 416-422-4322 تماس بگیرید.

c457ee975329.backTranslation: A local grassroots group operating out of Thorncliffe Park Social Hub (45 Overlea Blvd). Not currently listed on the official grassroots groups page — details unconfirmed, please verify before publishing.
c457ee975329.source: Grassroots community group based at Thorncliffe Park Community Hub (45 Overlea Blvd). Not currently listed on the official grassroots page — details unconfirmed, verify before publishing.
c457ee975329.text: یک گروه مردمی محلی که در مرکز اجتماعی تورنکلیف پارک (45 Overlea Blvd) فعالیت می‌کند. فعلاً در صفحه رسمی گروه‌های مردمی ثبت نشده است — جزئیات تأیید نشده‌اند، لطفاً قبل از انتشار، آن‌ها را بررسی کنید.

c6efc2c01c02.backTranslation: The Roman Catholic Church at the address 16 Thorncliffe Park Drive, which regularly holds Eucharist ceremonies, religious rituals, and church programs. This church introduces families to summer camp opportunities for children and teenagers offered at various churches under the Archdiocese of Toronto.
c6efc2c01c02.source: Roman Catholic parish at 16 Thorncliffe Park Drive offering regular Mass, sacraments and parish events. Connects families to summer camp opportunities for children and youth offered across parishes of the Archdiocese of Toronto.
c6efc2c01c02.text: کلیسای کاتولیک رومی در آدرس Thorncliffe Park Drive 16 که مراسم عشای ربانی، مناسک دینی و برنامه‌های کلیسایی را به‌طور منظم برگزار می‌کند. این کلیسا خانواده‌ها را با فرصت‌های اردوهای تابستانی برای کودکان و نوجوانان که در کلیساهای مختلف تحت پوشش اسقف‌نشین تورنتو ارائه می‌شود، آشنا می‌سازد.

problems: 'Faith-Based Organizations' was mistranslated as 'Religious organizations', which could mislead residents by implying a narrower scope of organizations than intended.
'Climate Resilience' mistranslated as 'resistance to climate change', which changes the meaning from adapting to climate impacts to opposing them.
d33e215aebeb.backTranslation: Food security and resistance to climate change
d33e215aebeb.text: امنیت غذایی و مقاومت در برابر تغییرات اقلیمی

d6ee993d9829.backTranslation: Emergency food assistance for needy families, its main service is during working hours; no separate emergency program is mentioned.
d6ee993d9829.source: Emergency food assistance for families in need is its core service during operating hours; no separate emergency program is listed.
d6ee993d9829.text: کمک غذایی اضطراری برای خانواده‌های نیازمند، خدمت اصلی آن در ساعات کاری است؛ هیچ برنامه اضطراری جداگانه‌ای ذکر نشده است.

problems: The back-translation changes 'violence-against-women program' to 'Fight Against Violence Against Women program', which could mislead residents about the specific program name.
The back-translation adds 'Energy' before 'Emergency Fund', which is not present in the original and could cause confusion about the fund's name.
d839bdfdb1e8.backTranslation: Emergency food assistance for families in need (free food distribution twice a month). No shelter, cooling center, or specific emergency line services are confirmed by the Food Collaborative. The organization provides crisis intervention and counseling services through the "Fight Against Violence Against Women" program; it also operates as an access point for the Toronto Rent Bank and the Energy Emergency Fund call center (416-397-7368).
d839bdfdb1e8.source: Emergency food support for families in need (free food distribution twice monthly). No shelter, cooling centre, or crisis-line services specific to the Food Collaborative were confirmed. Offers crisis intervention and counselling through its violence-against-women program; acts as a Toronto Rent Bank Access Centre and Emergency Energy Fund call centre (416-397-7368).
d839bdfdb1e8.text: کمک غذایی اضطراری برای خانواده‌های نیازمند (توزیع رایگان غذا دو بار در ماه). هیچ پناهگاه، مرکز خنک‌سازی یا خدمات خط اضطراری خاص Food Collaborative تأیید نشده است. این سازمان از طریق برنامه «مبارزه با خشونت علیه زنان»، خدمات مداخله در مواقع بحران و مشاوره ارائه می‌دهد؛ همچنین به عنوان مرکز دسترسی به Toronto Rent Bank و مرکز تماس صندوق اضطراری انرژی فعالیت می‌کند (416-397-7368).

problems: Program name changed from 'Safe Arrival Program' to 'Safe Entry' program'
d9ee2590bc2e.backTranslation: It runs the "Safe Entry" program (staff call parents if a child is unexpectedly absent); no special service for emergencies is mentioned.
d9ee2590bc2e.source: Operates a Safe Arrival Program (staff contact parents if a child is absent without notice); no emergency-specific services listed.
d9ee2590bc2e.text: برنامه «ورود ایمن» را اجرا می‌کند (کارکنان در صورت غیبت ناگهانی کودک با والدین تماس می‌گیرند)؛ هیچ خدمت ویژه‌ای برای موارد اضطراری ذکر نشده است.

dd60669c88d7.backTranslation: The shopping center located at 45 Overlea Blvd, which includes retail stores, restaurants, and everyday services (supermarket, bank, pharmacy/laboratory, gym, and hair salon). It is also the location of social service agencies such as the Afghan Women's Organization, Don Valley Community Legal Services, and Health Access Thorncliffe Park.
dd60669c88d7.source: Neighbourhood shopping mall at 45 Overlea Blvd with retail stores, restaurants and everyday services (grocery, bank, pharmacy/lab, fitness, hair salon). Also houses community service tenants such as the Afghan Women's Organization, Don Valley Community Legal Services and Health Access Thorncliffe Park.
dd60669c88d7.text: مرکز خرید محل در آدرس 45 Overlea Blvd که شامل فروشگاه‌های خرده‌فروشی، رستوران‌ها و خدمات روزمره (سوپرمارکت، بانک، داروخانه/آزمایشگاه، باشگاه ورزشی و آرایشگاه) می‌باشد. همچنین محل استقرار نهادهای خدمات اجتماعی مانند سازمان زنان افغان، خدمات حقوقی جامعه دون ولی و Health Access Thorncliffe Park است.

problems: The back-translation uses 'Jamakhana' instead of 'Jamatkhana', which could cause confusion.
The back-translation uses 'classrooms' instead of 'teaching spaces', which is a minor change but could be misleading.
The back-translation uses 'administrative offices' instead of 'offices', which is a minor change but could be misleading.
The back-translation uses 'food distribution section' instead of 'food drop-off area', which could imply a different service.
dddae32defdd.backTranslation: The Ismaili Community Centre and Jamatkhana (Jamakhana) is located at 80 Overlea Boulevard in Thorncliffe Park. The centre holds daily congregational prayers and gatherings for the Ismaili Muslim community; the building includes a gymnasium, library, classrooms, administrative offices, and a food distribution section.
dddae32defdd.source: Ismaili community centre and prayer hall (Jamatkhana) at 80 Overlea Boulevard in Thorncliffe Park. Hosts daily congregational prayers and community gatherings for Ismaili Muslims; the building includes a gymnasium, library, teaching spaces, offices and a food drop-off area.
dddae32defdd.text: مرکز جامعه و نمازخانه اسماعیلیه (جماعت‌خانه) در آدرس 80 Overlea Boulevard در Thorncliffe Park واقع شده است. این مرکز نمازهای روزانه جمعی و گردهمایی‌های جامعه مسلمانان اسماعیلی را برگزار می‌کند؛ این ساختمان شامل سالن ورزشی، کتابخانه، کلاس‌های آموزشی، دفاتر اداری و بخش تحویل مواد غذایی است.

problems: The back-translation incorrectly states the phone number as a 'postal code' instead of a phone number.
The back-translation uses '13:45' instead of '1:45pm', which could cause confusion for residents unfamiliar with 24-hour time.
de5580650854.backTranslation: The Fraser Mustard EarlyON Center for Children and Families (located at Fraser Mustard Early Learning Academy, address: 82 Thorncliffe Park Dr, East York; postal code: 416-394-2104) is a free and open program for parents and caregivers of children from birth to 6 years old. This program is active from Monday to Thursday from 8:45 to 13:45. Children can play, explore the environment, learn, and enjoy a nutritious snack; while parents can meet other families and obtain information about local programs and services with the help of an experienced Early Years specialist. Prior registration is not required.
de5580650854.source: The Fraser Mustard EarlyON Child and Family Centre (at Fraser Mustard Early Learning Academy, 82 Thorncliffe Park Dr, East York; 416-394-2104) is a free drop-in program for parents and caregivers with children from infants to 6 years, running Mon–Thu 8:45am–1:45pm. Children can play, explore, learn, and enjoy a nutritious snack while parents connect with other families and get information about community programs and services, supported by a qualified early-years professional; no pre-registration required.
de5580650854.text: مرکز کودکان و خانواده‌های Fraser Mustard EarlyON (واقع در Fraser Mustard Early Learning Academy، آدرس: 82 Thorncliffe Park Dr, East York؛ کد پستی: 416-394-2104) یه برنامه رایگان و آزاد برای والدین و مراقبان کودکان از بدو تولد تا 6 ساله. این برنامه دوشنبه تا پنجشنبه از ساعت 8:45 تا 13:45 فعاله. بچه‌ها می‌تونن بازی کنن، محیط رو کشف کنن، یاد بگیرن و از یه میان‌وعده مقوی لذت ببرن؛ در همین حال والدین می‌تونن با خانواده‌های دیگه آشنا بشن و با کمک یه متخصص آموزش اولیه (Early Years) مجرب، اطلاعات مربوط به برنامه‌ها و خدمات محلی رو به دست بیارن. ثبت‌نام قبلی لازم نیست.

e04d44a05f5d.backTranslation: Multi-Service Youth Bureau (active since 1971) that provides daily therapeutic, vocational training, and personalized care planning services for youth who are facing challenges in school, home, and life; these services also include child welfare and juvenile justice supports.
e04d44a05f5d.source: Multi-service youth agency (operating since 1971) providing day treatment, job training, and individualized care planning for youth facing challenges at school, at home and in life, including child welfare and youth justice supports.
e04d44a05f5d.text: اداره چندخدمتی جوانان (فعال از سال 1971) که خدمات روزانه درمانی، آموزش حرفه‌ای و برنامه‌ریزی مراقبتی شخصی‌شده را برای جوانانی که در مدرسه، خانه و زندگی با مشکلات روبرو هستند، ارائه می‌دهد؛ این خدمات شامل حمایت‌های رفاه کودکان و عدالت جوانان نیز می‌شود.

problems: Repeated 'Judo' in the martial arts list, which should be 'Jodo' as per the original.
e0aa03a9fd6a.backTranslation: The Japan Cultural Center, located at 6 Sakura Way, is open to all and offers cultural classes (Ikebana flower arrangement, Chado tea ceremony, Shodo calligraphy, Sumi-e painting, Taiko drumming, Koto playing), martial arts (Judo, Karate, Kendo, Aikido, Kyudo, Iaido, Naginata, Judo), Japanese language classes for adults, clubs (Karaoke, Hula, Dance, Seniors Club, Ping Pong), seasonal festivals, the Toronto Japanese Film Festival, exhibitions, and the Moriyama Nikkei Heritage Center.
e0aa03a9fd6a.source: Japanese cultural centre at 6 Sakura Way, open to everyone, offering cultural classes (ikebana flower arranging, chado tea ceremony, shodo calligraphy, sumi-e painting, taiko drumming, koto), martial arts (judo, karate, kendo, aikido, kyudo, iaido, naginata, jodo), Japanese language classes for adults, clubs (karaoke, hula, dance, seniors' club, ping pong), seasonal festivals, the Toronto Japanese Film Festival, exhibitions, and the Moriyama Nikkei Heritage Centre.
e0aa03a9fd6a.text: مرکز فرهنگی جاپان در آدرس 6 Sakura Way، برای همه باز است و کلاس‌های فرهنگی (آرایش گل ایکبانا، مراسم چای چادو، خوشنویسی شودو، نقاشی سومی-ای، نواختن طبل تایکو و کوتو)، هنرهای رزمی (جودو، کاراته، کندو، آیکیدو، کیودو، ایایدو، ناگیناتا، جودو)، کلاس‌های زبان جاپانی برای بزرگسالان، باشگاه‌ها (کارائوکه، هولا، رقص، باشگاه سالمندان، پینگ‌پنگ)، جشنواره‌های فصلی، جشنواره فیلم جاپانی تورنتو، نمایشگاه‌ها و مرکز میراث موریاما نیکِی را ارائه می‌دهد.

e5edc4998f24.backTranslation: A social and recreational center managed by the municipality at the address 29 St Dennis Dr, which includes an indoor pool (for swimming classes and recreational swimming), sports facilities, and a library branch, and offers registered recreational programs.
e5edc4998f24.source: City-run community/recreation centre at 29 St Dennis Dr with an indoor pool (swim lessons, leisure swims), fitness facilities, and a library branch, offering registered recreation programs.
e5edc4998f24.text: مرکز اجتماعی و تفریحی تحت مدیریت شهرداری در آدرس 29 St Dennis Dr که شامل استخر سرپوشیده (برای کلاس‌های شنا و شنای تفریحی)، امکانات ورزشی و یک شعبه کتابخانه است و برنامه‌های تفریحی ثبت‌شده را ارائه می‌دهد.

problems: The name of the location is incorrect: 'Thorncliffe Park Community Hub' is mistranslated as 'Thorncliffe Park Social Hub'.
The service 'career exploration' is mistranslated as 'job identification'.
The service 'training-needs assessment' is mistranslated as 'assessment of educational needs'.
The service 'one-on-one career support' is mistranslated as 'individual career counseling'.
The service 'job-posting help' is mistranslated as 'job posting registration'.
e6b5bb4495c9.backTranslation: The free "Employment Ontario" program of TNO is located at the Thorncliffe Park Social Hub (45 Overlea Blvd, Unit 200) and is open to all Ontario residents. This program offers services including job identification, assessment of educational needs, job search and retention skills, recruitment events, information sessions, training workshops, and individual career counseling. Additionally, for employers, free human resources services, new employee onboarding, and job posting registration are available.
e6b5bb4495c9.source: TNO's free Employment Ontario program at the Thorncliffe Park Community Hub (45 Overlea Blvd, Unit 200), open to all Ontario residents. Offers career exploration, training-needs assessment, job search and retention skills, hiring events, information sessions, workshops and one-on-one career support, plus free HR, onboarding and job-posting help for employers.
e6b5bb4495c9.text: برنامه رایگان «اشتغال انتاریو» (Employment Ontario) متعلق به TNO در مرکز اجتماعی «تورنکلیف پارک» (45 Overlea Blvd, Unit 200) دایر است و برای تمام ساکنان انتاریو باز می‌باشد. این برنامه خدماتی شامل شناخت مشاغل، ارزیابی نیازهای آموزشی، مهارت‌های جستجوی کار و حفظ شغل، رویدادهای استخدامی، جلسات اطلاع‌رسانی، کارگاه‌های آموزشی و مشاوره انفرادی شغلی را ارائه می‌دهد. همچنین برای کارفرمایان، خدمات رایگان منابع انسانی، پذیرش کارکنان جدید و ثبت آگهی استخدام فراهم است.

e84d3a5ba49c.backTranslation: The Leaside Towers Tenants Association page for 85 and 95 Thorncliffe Park Drive, serves as a contact guide for residents: Property Manager (Morguard) at 416-421-8109 and Building Security Guards (85 Building: 647-462-0404; 95 Building: 416-906-7970).
e84d3a5ba49c.source: The Leaside Towers Tenants Association page for 85 & 95 Thorncliffe Park Drive functions as a contact directory for residents: property manager (Morguard) at 416-421-8109 and building security guards (Building 85: 647-462-0404; Building 95: 416-906-7970).
e84d3a5ba49c.text: صفحه انجمن مستاجرین Leaside Towers برای پلاک‌های 85 و 95 Thorncliffe Park Drive، به عنوان راهنمای تماس برای ساکنان عمل می‌کند: مدیر ملک (Morguard) به شماره 416-421-8109 و نگهبانان امنیتی ساختمان (ساختمان 85: 647-462-0404؛ ساختمان 95: 416-906-7970).

problems: Original mentions 'education, advocacy and events', back-translation uses 'training, supportive activities, and events' which changes the focus and omits 'advocacy'.
e8558cfa2f76.backTranslation: A social network that promotes cycling as a tool for empowering women from all backgrounds, especially newcomers to Canada who have been left behind from learning to ride due to their culture. This network brings together novice and experienced cyclists through group rides, training, supportive activities, and events, and through BikeMatchWCN, delivers donated bicycles to women in need.
e8558cfa2f76.source: Community network promoting cycling as empowerment for women of all backgrounds, especially newcomers to Canada whose culture prohibited them from learning to ride. Brings together new and experienced cyclists through group rides, education, advocacy and events, and connects donated bikes with women in need through BikeMatchWCN.
e8558cfa2f76.text: شبکه اجتماعی که دوچرخه‌سواری را به عنوان ابزاری برای توانمندسازی زنان با هر پیشینه‌ای، به‌ویژه تازه‌واردان به کانادا که به دلیل فرهنگشان از یادگیری دوچرخه‌سواری بازمانده‌اند، ترویج می‌کند. این شبکه از طریق دوچرخه‌سواری‌های گروهی، آموزش، فعالیت‌های حمایتی و رویدادها، دوچرخه‌سواران تازه‌کار و باتجربه را گرد هم می‌آورد و از طریق BikeMatchWCN، دوچرخه‌های اهدایی را به زنان نیازمند می‌رساند.

e8f0c19cdab7.backTranslation: The Macedonian Orthodox Cathedral, which has been serving the Macedonian community in Toronto for over 60 years. This church regularly holds worship services and religious celebrations and hosts educational, cultural, and charitable organizations that preserve and promote the Macedonian heritage.
e8f0c19cdab7.source: Macedonian Orthodox cathedral that has served Toronto's Macedonian community for over 60 years. Holds regular worship services and religious holidays, and hosts educational, cultural and charitable organizations that preserve and promote Macedonian heritage.
e8f0c19cdab7.text: کلیسای جامع ارتدوکس مقدونی که بیش از 60 سال است به جامعه مقدونی‌های تورنتو خدمت می‌کند. این کلیسا مراسم عبادی و جشن‌های مذهبی را به‌طور منظم برگزار می‌کند و میزبان سازمان‌های آموزشی، فرهنگی و خیریه‌ای است که میراث مقدونی را حفظ و ترویج می‌نمایند.

problems: Incorrect location name: 'Dan Mills' instead of 'Don Mills'
Misleading description of Mass as 'Holy Communion ceremony' which does not fully capture the nature of the service
Missing mention of 'sacraments' and 'ministries' in the back-translation
Added 'church activities' and 'special programs' which are not explicitly mentioned in the original
ea49f2274ddf.backTranslation: The Catholic Church in Dan Mills (150 Gateway Blvd) which holds the Holy Communion ceremony every day and every week and provides services including religious rituals (baptism, confession, communion, confirmation, marriage, anointing of the sick and burial ceremonies), church activities, special programs for youth and young adults, volunteer opportunities and social events for the church community.
ea49f2274ddf.source: Catholic parish in Don Mills (150 Gateway Blvd) offering daily and weekly Mass, sacraments (baptism, reconciliation, Eucharist, confirmation, marriage, anointing of the sick, funerals), ministries, youth and young adult ministry, volunteer opportunities, and parish community events.
ea49f2274ddf.text: کلیسای کاتولیک در دان میلز (150 Gateway Blvd) که هر روز و هر هفته مراسم عشای ربانی برگزار می‌کند و خدماتی شامل آیین‌های مذهبی (تعمید، اعتراف، عشای ربانی، تأیید ایمان، ازدواج، مسح بیماران و مراسم تدفین)، فعالیت‌های کلیسایی، برنامه‌های ویژه جوانان و بزرگسالان جوان، فرصت‌های داوطلبانه و رویدادهای اجتماعی برای جامعه کلیسا ارائه می‌دهد.

problems: Wrong school type for Valley Park: 'Middle School' in original vs. 'Secondary School' in back-translation.
Wrong council name: 'Parent Councils' in original vs. 'parent-teacher councils' in back-translation.
ebed9e902f38.backTranslation: A grassroots group that connects families from diverse backgrounds through gatherings, cultural celebrations, education, and volunteer activities. This group strives to combat social isolation and loneliness and supports children's education through active participation in the parent-teacher councils of Gateway Public School, Valley Park Secondary School, and Marc Garneau Collegiate Institute.
ebed9e902f38.source: A resident-led group bringing families together across diverse backgrounds through gatherings, cultural celebrations, education, and volunteer initiatives. Aims to combat social isolation and loneliness and supports children's education through active involvement in the Parent Councils of Gateway Public School, Valley Park Middle School, and Marc Garneau Collegiate Institute.
ebed9e902f38.text: یک گروه مردمی که خانواده‌ها با پیشینه‌های مختلف را از طریق گردهمایی‌ها، جشن‌های فرهنگی، آموزش و فعالیت‌های داوطلبانه به هم پیوند می‌دهد. این گروه برای مقابله با انزوای اجتماعی و تنهایی تلاش می‌کند و با مشارکت فعال در شوراهای اولیا و مربیان مدرسه دولتی Gateway، مدرسه متوسطه Valley Park و مؤسسه آموزشی Marc Garneau، از تحصیل کودکان حمایت می‌نماید.

problems: The term 'maintenance' was translated as 'repair', which could be misleading as it might imply a different scope of service.
The term 'building security contacts' was translated as 'building superintendents', which could mislead residents about who to contact for urgent building issues.
ec5b5ffd97a8.backTranslation: Emergency repair requests (nights, weekends and holidays): 416-207-8253. Contact information for building superintendents is also listed above for urgent building issues.
ec5b5ffd97a8.source: Emergency maintenance requests (nights, weekends & holidays): 416-207-8253. Building security contacts are also listed above for urgent building issues.
ec5b5ffd97a8.text: درخواست‌های تعمیرات اضطراری (شب‌ها، آخر هفته‌ها و تعطیلات): 416-207-8253. اطلاعات تماس با نگهبانان ساختمان هم برای مشکلات فوری ساختمان در بالا ذکر شده است.

ef9e53e990a8.backTranslation: Local congregation of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints at 24 Ferrand Drive, North York. Sunday worship includes the sacrament meeting and age-based group classes for all individuals from 18 months and older; everyone is invited to participate.
ef9e53e990a8.source: Local congregation of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints at 24 Ferrand Drive, North York. Sunday worship includes a sacrament meeting plus age-group classes for everyone from 18 months old and up; all are welcome to attend.
ef9e53e990a8.text: گردهمایی محلی کلیسای عیسی مسیح قدیسان آخرالزمان در نشانی 24 Ferrand Drive, North York. عبادت روز یکشنبه شامل جلسه قربانی مقدس (ساکرامنت) و کلاس‌های گروهی بر اساس سن برای همه افراد از 18 ماهگی به بالا است؛ همه برای شرکت در آن دعوت هستند.

f0173151ade9.backTranslation: A registered non-profit organization that supports newly arrived families, refugees, asylum seekers, and those moving from shelters to permanent homes. The organization distributes essential household items for free (seasonal clothing, shoes, kitchen utensils, bedding, bathroom supplies, and some furniture items) and holds workshops for newcomers on parenting, familiarization with local systems, and community resources.
f0173151ade9.source: Registered non-profit supporting newcomer families, refugees, asylum seekers and people moving from shelters into permanent housing. Distributes free household essentials (seasonal clothing, footwear, kitchenware, bedding, bath accessories and select furniture) and runs newcomer workshops on parenting, navigating local systems and community resources.
f0173151ade9.text: یک سازمان غیرانتفاعی ثبت‌شده که از خانواده‌های تازه‌وارد، پناهندگان، پناه‌جویان و کسانی که از پناهگاه‌ها به خانه‌های دائمی نقل مکان می‌کنند، حمایت می‌کند. این سازمان وسایل ضروری خانه را به صورت رایگان توزیع می‌کند (لباس‌های فصلی، کفش، لوازم آشپزخانه، رختخواب، لوازم حمام و برخی وسایل مبلمان) و کارگاه‌هایی برای تازه‌ورودان درباره تربیت کودک، آشنایی با سیستم‌های محلی و منابع جامعه برگزار می‌کند.

ff411a340bcb.backTranslation: A grassroots non-profit organization (established in 2018 by parents of children with autism and officially registered in 2020) that provides free, community-based, family-centered services for children and youth with autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders in East York. Programs include the Roots Youth Program (held from Monday to Saturday), weekend respite services, monthly parent support meetings, after-school homework assistance, free and inclusive summer camps and March (spring) break camps, back-to-school programs, educational workshops, and autism and disability awareness campaigns.
ff411a340bcb.source: Grassroots non-profit (founded 2018 by parents of children with autism, incorporated 2020) providing free, community-based, family-oriented services for children and youth with autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders in East York. Programs include Roots youth programs running Monday to Saturday, weekend respite, monthly parent support meetings, after-school homework support, free inclusive summer and March break camps, back-to-school events, educational workshops and autism/disability awareness campaigns.
ff411a340bcb.text: یک سازمان غیرانتفاعی مردمی (که در سال 2018 توسط والدین کودکان مبتلا به اوتیسم تأسیس و در سال 2020 به ثبت رسمی رسید) که خدمات رایگان، مبتنی بر جامعه و خانواده‌محور را برای کودکان و نوجوانان مبتلا به اوتیسم و سایر اختلالات عصبی-رشدی در ایست یورک ارائه می‌دهد. برنامه‌ها شامل برنامه‌های نوجوانان Roots (که از دوشنبه تا شنبه برگزار می‌شود)، خدمات مراقبت موقت در آخر هفته، جلسات ماهانه حمایت از والدین، کمک در انجام تکالیف بعد از مدرسه، اردوهای تابستانی و اردوهای تعطیلات مارس (بهار) رایگان و فراگیر، برنامه‌های بازگشت به مدرسه، کارگاه‌های آموزشی و کمپین‌های آگاهی‌بخشی درباره اوتیسم و معلولیت است.
